plugins.description: DSH Web GUI sidebar glance card: DeepSeek account balance, peak/off-peak billing countdown and today's spend / tokens / calls, seated right above the account row. Self-contained host half; @linxin666/dsh-usage optional.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-account-glance English | [中文](README.zh.md)


The live card: probed balance, Beijing peak / off-peak clock, and today's ledger.

A three-line glance card for the DSH Web GUI, seated **directly above** the sidebar's bottom-left **account / Settings** row: | Line | Content | | --- | --- | | 1 | DeepSeek **account balance** — probed from `/user/balance` with the host-held API key; hover names the source | | 2 | **Peak / off-peak** billing period, with a live countdown to the next flip and the discount in effect | | 3 | **Today's spend / tokens / calls**, plus a **manual refresh** button that forces one fresh probe | Peak / off-peak follows DeepSeek's official schedule (Beijing time, UTC+8 all year): **peak** is Monday–Friday `09:00–12:00` and `14:00–18:00` at full price, **every other hour** (nights and weekends included) is billed at **50% off**. The countdown switches to seconds for the final minute. ## Install Needs **DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 or newer**. No other plugin, no dependencies, no build step. ```bash git clone https://github.com/faith372/dsh-account-glance.git dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:./dsh-account-glance ``` The Plugins page also accepts the repository URL in its **Add plugin** dialog. Installing by hand: put the source at `\plugins\dsh-account-glance\`, add the package to both `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles`, then link it into `node_modules` (or run `pnpm install`). Do **not** add `account-glance` to `cordis.patch.yml` yourself — the package ships that row. **Upgrading from 1.3.x:** the host half is new, so restart DSH (or toggle this row off and on in the Plugins page) and refresh the page once. ## Turning it on and off Sidebar **Plugins** icon → **Installed** → **dsh-account-glance**: the card switch toggles the whole bundle, the row switch toggles this card. Instant — no restart, no refresh — and turning it off brings dsh-usage's own glance card back. ## Where the numbers come from Both data sources live in this plugin's own host half and are served over loopback-only routes (`api/dsh-account-glance/overview`, `.../refresh`); the API key never reaches the browser. - **Balance** — `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`, with the key resolved from the DSH credential store (pi-ai record → configured env reference → ambient env). No probe value falls back to the `account` Remote (Settings → Account & balance). A route pointed at a reseller is reported as unsupported rather than probed with the official endpoint; a failure keeps the last good number and flags the row. - **Today's usage** — folded from the session event stream into a small per-day ledger at `/account-glance/ledger.json` (atomic write, 180-day retention), keyed by **Beijing date**. - **Cost** is priced for DeepSeek official routes only (the published CNY peak / off-peak table). Other routes — a DashScope-compatible provider, for example — still count tokens and calls, at cost 0, so a mixed ledger never sums two currencies. - `@linxin666/dsh-usage` is **optional**: install it and nothing breaks — this card still reads its own route first, its glance card stays hidden, and its settings and usage pages keep working. Probing is a read-only account query: no prompt, no tokens, no credit. ## Verify ```bash npm test # node test/verify.mjs && node test/host-verify.mjs ``` Both suites run offline. The client suite boots the shipped `lib/client.js` against React / DOM stand-ins: seat and cadence, the probe outranking the account wallet, the fallback identity, the peak clock's boundary cases, the 15-second deadline, the refresh button, the degradation paths, and the dsh-usage fallback. The host suite covers the clock and price book, the ledger, credential resolution and probe shapes, the origin guard, session folding, the route fence, persistence across a restart, and the entry point. ## Known limitations - Hiding dsh-usage's glance card relies on its `data-dsh-plugin="usage"` / `data-dsh-part="foot-card"` attributes; if it renames them, both cards appear (nothing breaks). - The balance belongs to the DeepSeek account the configured key belongs to — swap the key, swap the number. - Cost appears for DeepSeek official routes only; other routes show tokens and calls without an amount. - With dsh-usage installed too, both plugins keep their own ledger (this one buckets days by Beijing date, dsh-usage by host-local date), so the two totals can differ slightly. - The card hides while the sidebar is collapsed to its 56 px rail, matching the shell's own foot area. ## License MIT — except `lib/host/*` and `lib/index.js`, adapted from [`@linxin666/dsh-usage`](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web) v0.4.4 (Apache-2.0). See [`THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) and [`LICENSE-APACHE`](LICENSE-APACHE).

plugins.description: DSH 的持久化共同白板插件：完整白板在左、原生对话在右，人和 AI 持续维护同一份草稿。基于 draft-board。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH-board

[![CI](https://github.com/MYming-yue/dsh-board/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/MYming-yue/dsh-board/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

**在 DSH 对话旁，放一张人和 AI 可以长期共同维护的白板。**

A persistent shared whiteboard beside the native DeepSeek Harness conversation.

DSH-board 是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的本地插件，基于 [draft-board](https://github.com/MYming-yue/draft-board)。白板保留理解和成果，对话用来提出问题、讨论与纠正：学一个概念、拆解一个产品，或持续打磨一个项目。

当前为 **0.1.5 早期试用版**。插件单独维护宿主集成，白板界面和模型通过 [upstream.json](upstream.json) 固定上游提交构建，不维护两套白板代码。已构建的安装包可以独立安装，无需相邻的 draft-board 仓库；尚未发布到 npm。

## 可以做什么

- 完整白板在左，DSH 原生对话在右；对话可展开／收起，分隔线可拖动调整宽度。
- 保留 Markdown、LaTeX、图片、卡片备注、关系、集合、布局、结构视图、历史和撤销／重做。
- 新开或切换聊天继续同一张白板，直到主动“新建”或“打开”另一份草稿。
- 选中卡片后发消息，AI 知道本条回复所指的对象；不改写用户回复，不自动附上卡片全文。
- AI 通过 `draft_board_read`／`draft_board_apply` 主动维护白板，复用原子批次、版本校验与整轮撤销。
- 在“设置 → DSH-board 白板”管理启用与卡片关联；关闭功能保留草稿。

## 兼容范围

| 项目 | 已验证范围 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH CLI | 0.1.5-rc.1 |
| DSH 组合包 | 0.1.5-rc.2 |
| 宿主 profile | web |
| 实际宿主联调 | Windows、Chrome |
| 构建环境 | Node.js 22+、npm、Git |

布局和消息提交适配依赖 DSH 当前接口，升级宿主后需要重新验证。其他 DSH 版本和操作系统的完整宿主集成尚未确认；欢迎附版本信息反馈。

## 安装试用版

先确保 DSH web profile 可以正常启动。到 [Releases](https://github.com/MYming-yue/dsh-board/releases) 下载 `dsh-board-0.1.5.tgz`；安装已构建的包不需要 Git、编译工具或 draft-board 源码。

以下为 PowerShell 示例，使用 GitHub CLI 下载。也可以在浏览器下载，再将最后一行改为安装包的绝对路径。

```powershell
$dshHomePath = if ($env:DSH_HOME) { $env:DSH_HOME } else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.dsh' }
$pluginDir = Join-Path $dshHomePath 'local-plugins'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $pluginDir | Out-Null
gh release download v0.1.5 --repo MYming-yue/dsh-board --pattern 'dsh-board-0.1.5.tgz' --dir $pluginDir
dsh plugin --profile web add ("file:" + (Join-Path $pluginDir 'dsh-board-0.1.5.tgz'))
```

安装后重启 DSH Web Host，并重新载入页面。在设置中找到“DSH-board 白板”，确认共同白板已启用。

DSH home 使用 `DSH_HOME`，未设置时默认 `~/.dsh`。不要将插件安装到另一个 profile 或 home。更新同样下载新版本安装包后执行 `add` 并重启；构建包使用不同版本和文件名，避免本地依赖缓存误用旧包。

## 第一次体验

1. 在白板上双击创建一张卡片。
2. 选中它，在右侧发送“给这张卡片补充解释”。
3. 观察 AI 工具记录与画布更新，点击“撤销最新一轮”回退该批次。
4. 新开聊天，确认仍然是当前白板。

AI 使用 DSH 原有模型、工具和审批流程。插件不增加模型 API 配置，不管理账户，也不添加云同步。

## 保存、上下文与管理

草稿位于 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-board/`，包含图片与历史；`current.json` 指向当前草稿。主动更换时保留前一份宿主文件。原生“打开”“保存”“另存为”继续可用：宿主持有一份副本，绑定的磁盘原文件仍通过白板保存入口回写，页面刷新后需重新绑定其文件句柄。

固定使用说明注册在系统提示末尾；卡片身份和短标题在本轮运行上下文末尾注入。相同关联复用原生快照，不为每条回复重复追加。不附上全文、时间戳或修订号，不重写既有历史；发生过变化的快照仍由宿主保留，缓存命中率取决于宿主和模型服务。

“设置 → DSH-board 白板”提供“启用共同白板”和“发送时关联选中的卡片”。关闭白板恢复完整聊天区、暂停白板工具，保留草稿与未提交输入；重新启用后继续维护。选项和待处理关联保存在 `plugin-state.json`。

浏览器约每 750ms 与宿主同步。输入、指针操作、布局和回放期间保留当前操作。并行修改冲突时保留双方内容、暂停镜像；另存为后重新打开副本，明确选择继续维护的版本。当前没有自动合并、多任务白板管理、多人协作、AI 图片解析或完整消息／批次追溯。

卸载插件：

```text
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-board
```

随后重启宿主；卸载不会删除 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-board/` 中的草稿。

## 从源码构建

```bash
git clone https://github.com/MYming-yue/dsh-board.git
cd dsh-board
npm ci
node node_modules/playwright-core/cli.js install chromium
npm run check
```

首次构建自动拉取锁定的 draft-board 提交并执行其锁定依赖安装，需要访问 GitHub 与 npm。源码缓存在被忽略的 `.upstream/`；构建产物位于 `lib/`。上游锁不变时复用缓存；更新需显式修改 `upstream.json` 并重新验证。构建不会读取个人 DSH 配置、模型凭据或草稿。

`npm run check` 执行上游类型检查、界面与模型构建、插件测试，以及真实浏览器的安装包检查。安装包检查从 tgz 解压运行，验证持久化、画布接收批次与整轮撤销，不调用模型 API。`DSH_BOARD_BROWSER=chromium` 可指定 Playwright Chromium；默认依次尝试系统 Chrome、Edge、Chromium。Linux 可用 `install --with-deps chromium`。

发布包：

```bash
npm run build
npm pack --pack-destination artifacts
```

贡献前阅读 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) 和 [规格](docs/spec.md)。涉及宿主接口的变化仍需在实际 DSH 中联调，不能只用合成宿主检查宣称兼容。

## 来源与许可

本项目采用 [MIT License](LICENSE)。插件最初位于 draft-board 的 `plugins/dsh-board/`，从提交 `c37c6fe` 拆出。

白板界面和纯模型来自锁定的 draft-board，安装包保留其许可证及来源。构建会收集所嵌入运行依赖的许可证，写入 `lib/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt`；包含 React、KaTeX、markdown-it、fflate、nanoid 等依赖的声明。DSH 本体由使用者单独安装，本插件不打包分发 DSH 源码。

plugins.description: DSH plugin: enforce AI rules and protect tools/paths from accidental modification.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-bulwark

DSH 插件：向 systemPrompt 注入守则段，并在工具调用层拦截受保护路径的修改与受保护插件的卸载。

## 功能

- **守则注入**：把一个可配置的守则段写进 systemPrompt，位置由中心顺序表推导。
- **路径保护**：拦截对 protectedPaths 内路径的写 / 删 / 移动（含相对路径与 cd 链解析、重定向、dd / truncate / tee、python / node 内联脚本）。
- **插件卸载保护**：命中 protectedRemovalPatterns 关键词的卸载 / 删除命令一律拦截。
- **配置热重载**：监听 config.json，改动后无需重启。
- **逃生通道**：一个环境变量即可完全禁用。

## 安装

```
dsh plugin add github:Hashing2030/dsh-bulwark
```

安装后重启 DSH 生效。

> **首次启动会看到一行提示**：
> `[dsh-bulwark:config] watcher unavailable, config changes need a restart: ENOENT...`
> 这不是错误。它表示 config.json 还没创建，热重载暂未启用。创建配置文件后此提示自动消失。

## 配置

配置文件路径：`$DSH_HOME/dsh-bulwark/config.json`（`DSH_HOME` 未设置时退回 `~/.dsh`）。

完整默认值：

```json
{
  "rulesText": "[dsh-bulwark 守则] 部分工具和路径受保护，不要尝试绕过。",
  "protectedPaths": [],
  "protectedRemovalPatterns": [
    { "keywords": ["dsh plugin", "remove", "dsh-bulwark"] },
    { "keywords": ["dsh plugin", "remove", "dsh-plugin-host-template"] },
    { "keywords": ["dsh plugin", "remove", "dsh-plugin-client-template"] },
    { "keywords": ["pnpm", "remove", "dsh-bulwark"] },
    { "keywords": ["npm", "uninstall", "dsh-bulwark"] }
  ]
}
```

字段说明见 [CONFIG.md](CONFIG.md)。

## 用 CLI 管理配置（推荐）

不建议手改 JSON。用 scripts/protect.sh：

```
# 从插件安装目录进入（路径按实际 profile 替换）
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-bulwark

./scripts/protect.sh add /path/to/protect
./scripts/protect.sh list
./scripts/protect.sh remove /path/to/protect
./scripts/protect.sh test "rm -rf /path/to/protect/foo"
./scripts/protect.sh set-rules "[dsh-bulwark 守则] 新的守则内容"
```

也可以克隆一份仓库，用仓库里的脚本操作同一个配置文件：

```
git clone https://github.com/Hashing2030/dsh-bulwark
cd dsh-bulwark
./scripts/protect.sh add /path/to/protect
```

完整命令说明见 [SCRIPT-USAGE.md](SCRIPT-USAGE.md)。

## 逃生通道

```
DSH_FORTRESS_DISABLE=1 dsh web
```

设置这个环境变量后，DSH 启动时完全不加载 dsh-bulwark。清除即恢复。

> 变量名 DSH_FORTRESS_DISABLE 中的 FORTRESS 是项目旧名（dsh-fortress）的遗留。改名时保留它是为了不破坏已有配置。

## 本地开发

```
pnpm install
pnpm build          # tsdown → dist/index.js
dsh web --patch cordis.yml    # 用源码路径加载，不用装
```

## 测试

```
pnpm test:e2e       # 71 条端到端回归
```

## 相关文档

- [配置说明](CONFIG.md)
- [脚本用法](SCRIPT-USAGE.md)
- [灾难恢复](DISASTER-RECOVERY.md)
- [测试说明](TESTING.md)
- [迁移记录](MIGRATION.md)

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: DSH host plugin: detect long tasks (long-output & multi-step) and auto-split them for small-context local models - parts skeleton or PLAN.md ledger plus injected execution rules.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-task-splitter

**A DSH host plugin that notices long tasks and splits them before they fail — built for small-context local models.**

[中文说明见下方](#中文说明)

Small local models (llama.cpp / Ollama, e.g. Qwen3 27B at IQ2 with `maxTokens: 8192`) fail long tasks in two
*completely different* ways. This plugin detects both on the **host side** and hands the model an executable
procedure, instead of hoping the model judges its own limits.

| | **Lane A — long output** | **Lane B — long workflow** |
|---|---|---|
| Example | "write a 3000-word industry report, 4 sections" | **"pick me a stock likely to rise tomorrow"** |
| Prompt shape | usually explicit | **often tiny** ("pick me a…") |
| Real bottleneck | the per-request output budget (`maxTokens`) | **step count and context**: tool output floods the window, a small model drifts, intermediate results get lost |
| What this plugin does | scaffolds `tasks/<slug>/parts/NN-*.md` + `MANIFEST.json`; one part per reply, then `assemble` | scaffolds `tasks/<slug>/PLAN.md` + `notes/`; **plan first, one step per reply, results on disk** |

## How it decides

Scoring runs in the host (no model cooperation needed):

- **Lane A signals** — explicit word/char count, explicit part count, numbered section list (used as part titles),
  long-document keywords + a writing verb, very long prompt, multi-deliverable phrasing.
- **Lane B signals** — decision/research verbs (pick / recommend / evaluate / compare / analyse / predict / research / screen)
  **plus** a data-dependent domain noun (stocks, funds, housing, flights, insurance, papers, competitors, laptop…),
  explicit multi-step phrasing, or "needs current external data".
- Single-lookup requests ("what's the weather tomorrow") are deliberately clamped below the threshold.

Examples:

| Prompt | Result |
|---|---|
| `what's the weather` | no split |
| `look up tomorrow's weather for me` | no split (single lookup) |
| `recommend me a movie` | no split (score 2 < 3) |
| **`pick me a stock likely to rise tomorrow`** | **Lane B** → `PLAN.md` + `notes/`, "plan first, one step per reply" |
| `compare these three laptops and pick one` | **Lane B** |
| `write a 3000-word industry report, 4 parts` | **Lane A** → 4-part skeleton |
| a prompt with a 1./2./3. section list | **Lane A** (part titles taken from the list) |

The procedure is injected with `agent/pre-step` **prepended to the very same request** (no extra round trip),
and only for steps that start from a human message.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-task-splitter
```

Restart DSH afterwards. To build from source: `npm pack` then
`dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add file:./dsh-task-splitter-0.1.0.tgz`.

Requires a DSH host that exposes `agent/pre-step`, `ctx.agents` and `ctx.sessions`
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent` / `dsh-session` `^0.1.1-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.1`).

## Configuration

```yaml
# in your profile cordis patch (or a home patch)
- id: task-splitter
  config:
    enabled: true
    providers: [qwen-local]   # empty array = every provider
    lanes: [parts, plan]      # drop one to disable that lane
    minScore: 3               # Lane A threshold
    workflowScore: 3          # Lane B threshold (raise to 4 to be more conservative)
    maxParts: 8               # Lane A: at most this many parts
    wordsPerPart: 900         # Lane A: target chars per part
    tasksDir: tasks           # relative to the session working directory
    toolPath: ''              # CLI used in the injected rules; defaults to the bundled one
```

## Bundled CLI

`dsh-task-parts` (also exported as `dsh-task-splitter/task-parts`) drives Lane A outside the model:

```bash
node bin/task-parts.mjs init <taskDir> --title "T" --parts "one|two|three"
node bin/task-parts.mjs status <taskDir>     # ✅/⬜ per part, exits 2 while incomplete
node bin/task-parts.mjs next <taskDir>       # the next part to write
node bin/task-parts.mjs assemble <taskDir>   # concatenates into final.md
```

## Limitations (please read)

- Lane B guarantees **process and honesty** (plan, evidence on disk, sources, uncertainty, "do not fabricate data"),
  **not** the correctness of the answer. A local model with no market/financial data source cannot honestly predict
  tomorrow's stock move — the procedure makes it say so instead of inventing numbers.
- Detection is heuristic. `workflowScore` / `minScore` are the knobs; the plugin never blocks a turn — worst case it
  adds one short instruction message.
- Tested against a Windows DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 host with llama.cpp-served Qwen3; 27 offline simulation cases ship in
  [`test-sim.mjs`](./test-sim.mjs) (not included in the npm tarball).

## License

MIT

---

## 中文说明

**DSH 宿主插件：在长任务失败之前识别它并拆开 —— 为小上下文本地模型而做。**

本地小模型（llama.cpp / Ollama，例如 `maxTokens: 8192` 的 Qwen3-27B IQ2）会在**两类完全不同的**长任务上翻车，
本插件在**宿主侧**把两类都识别出来，并交给模型一套可执行的规程，而不是指望模型自己判断极限。

| | **车道 A：产出型** | **车道 B：流程型** |
|---|---|---|
| 例子 | "写一篇 3000 字的行业报告，分 4 部分" | **"帮我选一只明天大概率会涨的股票"** |
| 提示词 | 通常明确 | **可能极短** |
| 真正瓶颈 | 单次输出预算（`maxTokens`） | **步骤数与上下文**：工具结果塞满窗口、小模型多步跑偏、中间结果丢失 |
| 插件动作 | 建 `tasks/<slug>/parts/NN-*.md` + `MANIFEST.json`；每轮只写一段，最后 `assemble` | 建 `tasks/<slug>/PLAN.md` + `notes/`；**先立计划、每轮一步、结果落盘** |

判定在宿主侧打分（不依赖模型自觉）：车道 A 看字数/分段/分节列表/长文关键词/超长提示词；
车道 B 看**决策研究类动词 + 依赖数据的领域名词**、显式多步措辞、是否需要实时外部信息；
单次查询类（"帮我查一下天气"）会被压到阈值以下。

规程通过 `agent/pre-step` **前置到同一次请求**里（不额外耗一轮），且只处理以人类消息开始的那一步。

安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add dsh-task-splitter
```

装完重启 DSH。配置项同上（`lanes` / `minScore` / `workflowScore` / `maxParts` / `wordsPerPart` / `tasksDir` / `toolPath`）。

**局限**：车道 B 保证的是**过程与诚实性**（计划、证据落盘、来源、不确定性、禁止编造数据），**不保证答案正确**；
本地没有行情/财务数据源时，它就该说"给不出可靠结论"，而不是编数字。检测是启发式的，
`workflowScore` / `minScore` 可调；最坏情况只是多注入一条很短的指令，不会阻塞任何一轮。

MIT 许可。

plugins.description: 流明市场：DSH 插件发现、介绍与文档、GitHub 仓库查验，以及官方管线安装和更新。
plugins.readme_text: # 流明市场 · Lumen Market [npm 包](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-lumen-market) · [GitHub 源码](https://github.com/Femad-6/dsh-lumen-market) · [问题反馈](https://github.com/Femad-6/dsh-lumen-market/issues) 为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 提供一个集**插件发现、介绍、文档、安装和更新**于一体的市场。你可以搜索 npm 与 GitHub 插件，也可以查看当前已安装的本地插件。 安装和更新由 DSH 官方插件管理器执行。点击确认前，市场会展示查验过的版本或 commit，以及兼容性信息。 当前源码版本为 **0.3.1**，更新内容见 [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md)。可通过 npm `dsh-lumen-market@0.3.1`、GitHub `v0.3.1` 标签或本地目录安装。npm 安装前也可在版本页面核对发布状态。 ## 实机截图 以下图片直接截取自运行中的 **DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用**，不是离线演示或设计稿。使用了自定义宿主主题；为保护隐私，仅裁去侧栏、会话列表和余额区域。截图中的版本和结果代表拍摄时的状态。 **发现插件：查看来源、简介、版本和兼容性。** ![DeepSeek Harness 中的流明市场发现页](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Femad-6/dsh-lumen-market/main/docs/screenshots/discover.png) **插件详情：阅读完整介绍，打开项目主页、仓库和 README。** ![DeepSeek Harness 中的流明市场插件详情](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Femad-6/dsh-lumen-market/main/docs/screenshots/detail.png) ## 能做什么 | 功能 | 用途 | | --- | --- | | 搜索插件 | 搜索 npm 与 GitHub，或直接输入仓库地址 | | 按星标排序 | 选择「GitHub 星标最多」，从高到低浏览 GitHub 候选 | | 了解插件 | 查看简介、完整描述和文档入口 | | 安装前查验 | 展示兼容性、确切版本或固定 commit | | 查看已安装 | 识别 npm、本地链接、Git 等不同来源 | | 检查更新 | 查找可更新的 npm 插件，逐项预览并原地升级 | | 重启提醒 | 更新后持续提示需要重启的插件 | | 安装进度与取消 | 查看查验、下载和应用阶段；支持的宿主可取消正在安装的目标 | ## 安装 使用带有官方插件管理功能的 DeepSeek Harness。插件已发布到 npm，包和仓库均包含可加载的 `lib/` 文件，无需自行构建。 ### 推荐：在 DSH 中通过 npm 包名安装 1. 打开侧栏 **「插件」→「添加插件」**。 2. 填入下面的 npm 安装目标： ```text dsh-lumen-market@0.3.1 ``` 3. 确认安装，按官方管理器的提示处理构建授权或重启。 4. 安装生效后，侧栏会出现 **「流明市场」**。 需要其他版本时，可在 [npm 版本页面](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-lumen-market?activeTab=versions) 确认版本号，再填写 `dsh-lumen-market@版本号`。 也可以让 DSH 使用官方管理工具完成安装： ```text plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "dsh-lumen-market@0.3.1" } ``` ### 可选：用 npm 下载到普通项目目录 需要 Node.js 22 或更高版本和 npm。在普通项目目录运行： ```sh npm install dsh-lumen-market@0.3.1 --ignore-scripts --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org ``` 这会将包下载到当前项目的 `node_modules/dsh-lumen-market`，不会自动在 DSH 中激活。要在 DSH 中使用，推荐通过上面的官方插件管理器安装；不要直接在 DSH 的 profile 目录执行 npm 安装。 ### 从 GitHub 安装 0.3.1 在 DSH 官方「添加插件」中填写： ```text github:Femad-6/dsh-lumen-market#v0.3.1 ``` 此示例使用本次版本标签。需要完整 commit SHA 时，可在 [GitHub 提交列表](https://github.com/Femad-6/dsh-lumen-market/commits/main/) 复制对应提交的完整 SHA，并替换末尾的 `v0.3.1`。流明市场内的 GitHub 安装预览仍会将仓库查验结果固定到完整 SHA。GitHub 来源不会获得 npm 来源的按包名更新按钮。 ### 从本地目录安装 适合希望修改代码或本地测试的用户。需要 Git、Node.js 22 或更高版本，以及 npm。 ```sh git clone https://github.com/Femad-6/dsh-lumen-market.git cd dsh-lumen-market npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund ``` 然后在 DSH「添加插件」中输入克隆目录的**绝对路径**。例如，克隆目录是 `C:\Plugins\dsh-lumen-market`，就填写该路径。请替换为你自己的实际目录。 本地安装通常会建立 link/junction。安装后不要移动目录；修改 host 代码后，需要正常退出并重新打开 DSH。 ## 开始使用 1. **找插件**：进入「发现」，输入关键词、`owner/repo` 或 GitHub 仓库根地址，选择来源后点击「搜索」。 2. **看介绍**：点击「查看详情」，阅读描述与兼容性，使用「查看文档」了解更多。 3. **装插件**：目标符合条件时，点击「安装预览」，核对版本或 commit，再点击「确认安装」。 4. **查更新**：进入「已安装」或「可更新」，点击「重新检查」。有更新时，逐项预览和确认。 「已安装」会先显示本地列表，再在后台查询更新。三个标签页的「重新检查」都会请求新数据；发现页的筛选条件不会影响已安装列表。输入完整 npm 包名时，市场优先直接查询该包，减少关键词搜索漏收录的影响。 发现页的「排序」可以选择 **「GitHub 星标最多」**，会自动切换到 GitHub 来源并回到第一页。仓库按星标数从高到低排列，翻页和重新检查会保持排序；卡片与详情展示取得的 GitHub 星标数。切换到 npm 或全部来源时恢复默认排序，星标排序仍遵守页面提示的 GitHub 搜索范围。 星标数当前只显示在 GitHub 来源结果中；npm、本地链接和已安装项尚未补查关联仓库的星标数，因此这些卡片不显示 star。 宽屏下，右侧详情会随列表滚动保持可见，点击列表下方的插件无需返回页面顶部。长详情可在面板内独立滚动，切换插件后从新详情顶部开始阅读；窄屏则在列表上方展示详情并自动定位。 安装期间会显示官方管理器报告的阶段。出现「取消操作」时可以发起取消；市场会等待安装进程结束和文件恢复后的最终结果。已经进入应用阶段时可能无法取消。安装失败时可展开「安装诊断」，查看失败分类、已脱敏的输出及待授权的构建提示。 只检查或浏览不会自动安装、更新插件。待重启提示在刷新页面后仍会保留，真正重启 DSH 后才清空。 ## 搜索来源 | 来源 | 搜索范围 | | --- | --- | | npm | 宿主配置的注册表；默认使用 npm 官方源，并带 npmmirror 回退 | | GitHub | 关键词搜索限定 `dsh-plugin` topic，按最近更新排序；直接输入仓库根地址可查验没有这个 topic 的仓库 | | 全部来源 | 合并 npm 与 GitHub，并在第一页显示匹配的本地已安装插件 | GitHub 搜索不是全仓库扫描。搜索结果只是候选，需要打开详情完成查验，才可能提供安装按钮。 npm 分页按查验后的候选显示，每页最多 20 项。为控制等待时间，每次最多扫描 3 页原始候选；达到上限会明确提示缩小关键词，不把原始搜索数量当成已验证插件总数。 ## 常见问题 **为什么搜不到某个插件？** 检查来源和筛选条件。找本地安装的插件时，选择「全部来源」并关闭「仅可安装」，或者进入「已安装」。找 GitHub 项目时，包名可能与仓库名不同；直接输入完整仓库地址更准确。网络失败、限流或注册表尚未收录也会影响结果。 **为什么显示“未验证”，没有安装按钮？** 首版只直接安装仓库根目录的单包插件。缺少 DSH 声明、缺少构建产物、导出路径无法完整查验或不兼容时，会显示原因。只有客户端模块、monorepo 子包和无法固定 commit 的目标也不会直接安装。静态查验不能保证插件运行成功，最终结果仍由官方管理器决定。 **为什么本地链接和 Git 插件没有升级按钮？** 按 npm 包名升级会替换原来的安装来源，因此只对符合条件的 npm 依赖提供更新。本地 link/file、Git、压缩包和 npm 别名不会被转换成注册表安装，也不会自动追踪新的 Git commit。 **安装或更新失败怎么办？** 查看页面错误和官方管理器的诊断。兼容性拒绝会说明不满足的 peer 范围；构建脚本授权也由官方处理。市场不会自动授权脚本、写入兼容性豁免或重试安装。若提示 profile 定位异常，可点击页面底部「诊断」查看原因；分享诊断前请检查路径等个人信息。 **GitHub 限流怎么办？** 等待页面显示的重试时间。匿名查询可用；需要提高配额时，可以在启动宿主的环境中设置专用变量 `DSH_LUMEN_MARKET_GITHUB_TOKEN`，具体说明见开发文档。不要将 token 放进仓库或截图。 ## 开发与反馈 开发命令、接口和验证说明见 [开发文档](https://github.com/Femad-6/dsh-lumen-market/blob/main/docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) 与 [验证摘要](https://github.com/Femad-6/dsh-lumen-market/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md)。隔离集成测试使用真实临时 profile 文件和 HTTP，但安装器是模拟实现；真实桌面升级与回滚仍按 [实机验收步骤](docs/MANUAL-ACCEPTANCE.md) 单独检查。离线预览使用模拟 API，实机截图来自桌面应用。 遇到问题可提交 [Issue](https://github.com/Femad-6/dsh-lumen-market/issues)，附上 DSH 版本、操作步骤和去除敏感信息后的截图。 ## 许可证 MIT。第三方依赖说明见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/Femad-6/dsh-lumen-market/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

# dsh-session-attention

![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-session-attention)
![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-session-attention)
![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-%3E%3D0.2.0--rc.2-blue)
![compat](https://github.com/Meltllsy/dsh-session-attention/actions/workflows/compat.yml/badge.svg)

DSH **会话注意力提醒**插件 —— 只管「DSH 会话」这一件事：

- **完成 / 提问 / 审批提醒**：agent 完成一轮回复（`turn/end` + `completed`）、用
  `ask_user_question` 提问、或有审批请求（`approval/asked`）时提醒你。三类可分别开关。
- **只在切出 DSH 时弹**：标签页可见时不打扰（你正看着屏幕，不需要提示）；切走时转成
  **系统原生通知** + **提醒音**，点通知回到 DSH。
- **活动悬浮球**：页面右下角可拖动的球，显示 DSH 当前活跃会话（思考中 / 执行工具 / 等待你，
  最多 5 个、按最近更新排序），有活动时发光脉动；点开可跳回对应会话；另有画中画悬浮窗。
- **侧边栏「提醒」入口**：开关、音量、音色、试听、系统通知授权、悬浮球设置。

> 本插件是 `dsh-todo-reminder` 拆出来的**会话模块**。个人待办（全局、与会话无关）留在
> `dsh-todo-reminder`，两者数据、设置、声效文件、接口全部独立，可单独安装、单独卸载。

## 安装

从 npm 装（推荐）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-session-attention    # 桌面端
dsh plugin --profile web     add dsh-session-attention    # 浏览器版
```

从源码装（仓库里已带构建产物 `lib/`，克隆后可直接指过去）：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Meltllsy/dsh-session-attention.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<克隆目录>
```

> 改了源码想重新构建：`npm install && npm run prepack`（host 半 `tsc` → `lib/`，client 半 `tsdown` → `lib/client.js`）。
## 设置与数据

| 项 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 设置文件 | `$DSH_HOME/session-attention/settings.json`（原子写） |
| 自定义提醒音 | `$DSH_HOME/session-attention/session.{mp3,wav,ogg,m4a}` |
| 旧位置（仍然有效） | `$DSH_HOME/todo-reminder/session.*` |
| HTTP 接口 | `/api/attention/state`、`/api/attention/set-settings`、`/api/attention/events`（SSE）、`/api/attention/sound` |

**一次性迁移**：首次运行时若本模块的设置文件不存在，会从旧插件
`$DSH_HOME/todo-reminder/todos.json` 的 `settings.attention` / `settings.ball`
读一次当种子并立即落盘；旧文件不删，回滚安全。

## 音效怎么走

1. **自定义音效文件优先**：设置面板里点过试听/在页面点过任意位置后，音频解锁并探测
   `/api/attention/sound`，命中则解码为 AudioBuffer 使用。
2. **内置合成音兜底**：没有文件 / 解码失败时用 WebAudio 现场合成（info / success / warning / danger 四套音色）。
3. **系统通知兜底**：音频尚未解锁时，由系统通知自己出声（`silent: false`）。

音频解锁靠 document 上的手势监听自动完成（点 DSH 里任何地方即可），不需要专门操作。
页面内音效在前台/后台都会响；**页面完全关闭时不会响**，那时只有系统通知，而浏览器通知
只能用系统默认音（浏览器 API 不允许指定自定义音）。

## 限制

- 提醒需要 GUI 标签页存在（后台亦可）；页面完全关闭期间不会有任何提醒。
- 活动悬浮球、画中画、侧边栏入口都是 DOM 注入，依赖 DSH shell 的类名；shell 大改版可能需同步更新选择器。

## 构建

```bash
npm install          # 只需一次
npm run prepack      # host 半 tsc → lib/；client 半 tsdown → lib/client.js
```

host 半只依赖 `node:` 内置模块（自包含）；client 半经 tsdown 打包为 ModuleLoader 客户端，React 交给宿主运行时。

## 兼容性

本插件依赖 DSH 的一些**内部点**（服务名、事件名、DOM 类名、客户端包格式）。DSH 演进较快，
这些点在版本之间**会变** —— 插件断掉往往不是插件自己的 bug，而是这里变了。所以仓库里带了一个自检脚本：

```bash
npm run check:compat                        # 检查本机已装的 DSH
node scripts/check-compat.mjs --from <dir>  # 检查指定目录（CI 用）
```

实测结果：

| DSH 版本 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `0.2.0-rc.2`（当前） | ✅ 15/15 |
| `0.2.1-alpha.2`（下一个） | ✅ 15/15 |

依赖点一览（断哪条、坏哪个功能，脚本输出里都写了）：

| 分类 | 依赖点 |
|---|---|
| 客户端 | `__ModuleLoader__` 加载器格式、`/plugins` 资源路由 |
| 服务 | `uiWorkspace.openSession`、会话列表 `byId` 快照、host 的 `webServer` / `systemPrompt` |
| DOM | 类名含 `sessionRow` / `newSession` / `centerCol` |
| 事件 | `session/event` / `turn/end` / `approval/asked` / `tool/call` |
| 工具 | `ask_user_question` |

**GitHub Actions 每周自动跑一次**（含 alpha 版本），不通过就自动开 issue —— 所以 DSH 更新导致的不兼容
会被提前发现，而不是等用户先撞上。

> 与 [dsh-todo-reminder](https://github.com/Meltllsy/dsh-todo-reminder) 是各自独立的插件，互不依赖，可单独安装。

## 截图

> 待补：截图放 `docs/` 下，然后把这一行换成 `![面板](docs/panel.png)`。

plugins.readme_text:
# Analog Liquid Glass for DeepSeek Harness

> **把 DeepSeek Harness 的输入框变成一片模拟质感的液态玻璃。**

顶部镜面高光、内缘白线、边缘溢出的一圈柔光；模型思考时玻璃里往上冒泡；
深浅主题切换带 1.7 秒的从容过渡。

名字里的 **Analog** 指**模拟仪表那种质感**（弯液面、观液管、刻度），不是技术上的"模拟/数字"
—— 对应插件里的玻璃容器、液位式进度与上升的气泡，也与"数字进度条"划清界线。图标即为此意。

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/Siloet-phy/analog-liquid-glass-for-dsh)

![浅色](docs/light.png)
![深色](docs/dark.png)

## 安装

从 GitHub 安装（**当前推荐**，本包尚未发布到 npm）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:Siloet-phy/analog-liquid-glass-for-dsh
```

> 桌面版 DSH 的包管理需要**先完全退出 DSH** 再执行；装完重启生效。
> profile 名一般是 `desktop`（桌面版）或 `web`（`dsh web` 起的服务）。

如果只想用短名（需要在 npm 上已发布同名包）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add analog-liquid-glass-for-dsh
```

## 它做了什么

| 元素 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **磨砂层** | 白雾 + 重度模糊，是"玻璃感"的来源（不是简单叠一层半透明） |
| **顶部镜面高光** | 玻璃最容易辨认的那道柔光 |
| **内缘白线** | 上缘一道发丝白线 |
| **外扩散泛光** | 光从玻璃边缘微微溢到外面一圈 |
| **三点吐泡泡** | **只在模型思考时出现**：三颗泡错开 1/3 周期、同一个出生点，一个破灭、一个新生 |
| **主题过渡** | 浅 ↔ 深切换时，玻璃比整页更慢地插值（1.7s vs 0.9s） |
| **真毛玻璃** | 为做出磨砂感，覆盖原生卡片的背景与 `backdrop-filter`（见下方"设计决定"第 2 条） |

## 两个我坚持的设计决定

1. **玻璃里不放颜色。**
   真正的液态玻璃几乎是"无色"的——透白玻璃 + 染白的雾 + 白边色散。
   颜色只允许出现在**边缘的高光**上。任何"玻璃内部有一团彩色在流动"的做法，
   看着都会像彩色塑料。（我做出过六版彩色玻璃，全被否了。）
2. **玻璃层只往 slot 里"加层"**，靠测量原生卡片的矩形贴合尺寸，不改它的 DOM 结构。
   唯一例外是"真毛玻璃"：为做出磨砂感，会覆盖 `[data-composer-card]` 的背景与
   `backdrop-filter`（这是毛玻璃唯一能成立的物理位置——在卡片内容之上加雾会把文字压淡，
   对它做 `backdrop-filter` 会把文字一起糊掉）。该段集中在 `client.js` 一处、带注释与旋钮，
   删掉即回到纯加层模式；`/` 菜单底板那处小修复同理可删。卸载后不留任何样式。

## 图标

`icon.svg` 的立意是**模拟仪表**，和"数字进度条"划清界线：

一根竖直的**玻璃观液管**（sight tube），里面一柱淡蓝液体，顶端一道**弯液面**
（液体贴管壁上翘的那道弧，是"模拟时代"最一眼可辨的符号），液柱里两点气泡正在上升。
—— 玻璃是容器、液位是进度、气泡是"模型正在思考"，正好对应插件的三件事。

配色与插件本体一致（天蓝 `112,176,244` 为主、冷白为釉）。
多尺寸与深浅底的对照见 [`docs/icon-preview.html`](docs/icon-preview.html)；
设计草图留在 [`docs/icon-concept.svg`](docs/icon-concept.svg)，
上一版图标备份在 [`docs/icon-previous.svg`](docs/icon-previous.svg)。

## 兼容性

- **DSH**：`0.2.0-rc.2` 及以上（依赖 `conversation.input.overlay` slot 与
  `ctx.theme` 的 `theme/change` 事件）。
- **平台**：Web 客户端（桌面版内置浏览器 / `dsh web`）。纯 CLI 会话不受影响。
- **浏览器**：Chromium 系（Electron）。用到 `backdrop-filter` 与 `color-mix()`，需要现代内核。
- **无障碍**：遵循 `prefers-reduced-motion`——开启后所有动画停止，只保留静态玻璃与状态色。

## 开发

```bash
node selftest.mjs                      # 19 项断言：替身环境，验证模块面与 apply() 行为
node livetest.mjs [react-umd 目录]      # 30 项断言：真 React + 真 DOM，验证真的能渲染
```

- **`selftest.mjs`**：用替身把客户端 bundle 完整跑一遍——语法、模块面（`name`/`inject`/`apply`）、
  `apply()` 在有无服务时的行为、slot 注册目标、样式挂载、`theme/change` 订阅、组件渲染。
  **改完 `client.js` 先跑它**，因为客户端 bundle 一旦在最顶层抛错会牵连 Web 端模块系统。
- **`livetest.mjs`**：需要 `react`/`react-dom`/`jsdom`（**故意不进 package.json 依赖**，
  避免让插件包带上开发期重量）。它用**真 React** 把玻璃层真的挂进真 DOM，并验证
  几何锚定（含"包含块非视口"时的差值归零）、fail-closed 行为、
  `running` 状态翻转时 `data-busy` / `data-on` 跟着变、卸载后 DOM 清干净。

> 两个测试装置上的坑（都写进注释了）：
> ① `document`/`window` 必须在 `require('react-dom')` **之前**就位；
> ② 必须用 `createRoot` + `act()`，**不能用 legacy `ReactDOM.render`**——
>    legacy render 会把 passive effects 推到下一个任务，同步断言时会看到
>    "玻璃层没进 DOM"这种**假失败**。

## 技术笔记

- **主题**：直接消费 DSH 的 `--dsw-*` token 与 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`，
  **不自己管理主题状态**；过渡窗口通过监听 `ctx.theme` 的 `theme/change` 事件实现。
- **挂点**：`conversation.input.overlay`（list，session 作用域）；
  "模型是否在思考"来自标准 props 的 `useSession((s) => s.running)`，
  取不到时退化为观察原生按钮的「发送 ↔ 停止」态（MutationObserver），保证气泡不会静默失效。
- **几何**：玻璃层用 `position:fixed` + 实测原生卡片矩形写进 CSS 变量。
  ⚠ 取的是「卡片矩形 − 自身矩形」的**差值**，不能直接用卡片的视口坐标——
  卡片一旦带 `backdrop-filter` 就会成为 fixed 的包含块，直接写会偏移叠加两次。
  找不到卡片则整体隐藏（fail-closed）。
- **踩过的坑**（都写进注释了）：
  - **已删除的「镶边」**：曾用"放大盒子 + `mask-composite` 只留边线"做 1.5px 绕行亮边，
    深色下会变成**一圈巨大的旋转发光矩形**（用户点名要求删掉）。教训：`mask-composite`
    必须 `-webkit-` 前缀与标准属性**双写**，且**绝不要放大盒子**；要做镶边应让盒子就是玻璃本身。
  - 玻璃里的彩色无论多淡都会显土；低饱和色块压在深底上还会变泥浆色。
  - 循环动画必须让元素在关键帧里**自己收束**——曾做成"无限上浮"，到顶被裁掉，看不出破灭。
  - 给会动的元素做 `scaleY` 调幅度时**必须显式写 `transform-origin`**，否则元素会"消失"。
  - 读 `getComputedStyle` / 条件调用 hook 都会在真实环境里炸；前者要 try/catch，后者要定序。
- **参考**：
  [wxperia/liquid-glass-vue](https://github.com/wxperia/liquid-glass-vue) 与
  [rdev/liquid-glass-react](https://github.com/rdev/liquid-glass-react)（折射位移图的算法来源），
  以及 Apple 的液态玻璃设计语言。

## 截图说明

`docs/light.png` 与 `docs/dark.png` 是设计稿（单文件 HTML 演示）在浏览器里的实拍；
插件的实现与设计稿逐像素对齐（同一套 CSS）。设计稿与全部探索过程在同一作者的
`magic-cast` 工作目录里，未随包发布。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> remove analog-liquid-glass-for-dsh
```

卸载后输入框恢复原样，不会残留样式（样式表随插件生命周期移除）。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: Session deletion for DeepSeek Harness: recoverable trash-based delete, a sidebar menu row, and session_delete / session_restore agent tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-delete

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

[![test](https://github.com/hakulat2023/dsh-session-delete/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/hakulat2023/dsh-session-delete/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0b7285)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

Session **deletion** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

DeepSeek Harness can archive a Session, but archiving only hides it — there is no way to get rid of
one. This plugin adds that missing verb: **Delete session** in the Session row's “…” menu, a
`remote.sessionDelete` host namespace, and the `session_delete` / `session_restore` agent tools.

Deletion is deliberately **recoverable**: the Session's durable log is moved into a local trash
directory, so a mistake costs a `mv`, not a conversation.

- [What it does](#what-it-does)
- [Requirements](#requirements)
- [Install](#install)
- [Use](#use)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [Semantics and limits](#semantics-and-limits)
- [Development](#development)
- [Verified behaviour](#verified-behaviour)
- [License](#license)

## What it does

One deletion performs four steps:

1. **Admission.** The Session is asked the same questions archiving asks, through the
   `workspace/session-activity` waterfall. Live work is refused unless the caller allows a stop;
   when it is, `workspace/session-stop` cancels the turn and the plugin waits (bounded) for the
   Session to go idle. A Session still resident in the host process is refused *before any side
   effect* and only deleted after a second, explicit confirmation.
2. **Move the log.** The Session's own directory is moved — an atomic `rename` on one filesystem,
   degrading to copy-and-remove across devices — into
   `$DSH_HOME/session-trash/<sessionId>-<timestamp>/`, together with a `trash.json` record naming
   the Session, its title, `cwd`, original directory, byte/file counts, and deletion time.
3. **Drop the registrations.** The Session is detached from every Workspace account
   (`sessionIds`), removed from the registry-global archive and pin sets, and its projection-cache
   record is deleted.
4. **Tell the UI.** `api-session/removed` is emitted, so every connected browser drops the row
   immediately.

The Session directory is located through the persistence backend's own `locate(header)` when it
offers one, so a backend that changes its on-disk layout does not need a plugin update; otherwise the
plugin falls back to the documented `sessions/<projectKey(cwd)>/<encodeSegment(id)>` layout.

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.x` (developed and verified against `0.2.0-rc.2`) |
| Node.js | `>= 20` |
| Surface | any profile that mounts the Session store, the JSONL persistence backend, the Workspace registry, and the Web client (`dsh-web-app` / desktop) |

The plugin has **no npm dependencies** and **no build step**: the browser half is a hand-written
module in the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` shape the Web client already consumes,
and the host half imports nothing outside `node:*`. See
[docs/plugin-packaging.md](docs/plugin-packaging.md) for why that matters for third-party plugins.

## Install

The package is a DSH **bundle**: `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and `dsh.client`, and
`cordis.patch.yml` inserts the host row.

```bash
# from a local checkout (this repository)
plugin_manager install_bundle   target: /absolute/path/to/dsh-session-delete

# or from GitHub, by tag, with the bundled CLI
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:hakulat2023/dsh-session-delete#v0.1.0

# or from the registry, once published
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-session-delete
```

The bundle patch that gets mounted is one row:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-delete
      name: dsh-session-delete
```

After installing, **restart the application once**. The host half is a Node ESM module and the
running process keeps the module generation it already loaded (DSH's own limitation: a replaced
package needs a restart to load fresh JavaScript). The browser half is served from disk and only
needs a page reload.

## Use

### Web UI

Session row → **“…”** → **Delete session** → confirm.

- A **running** Session is stopped first: the first confirmation already carries that intent.
- A Session that is still **resident** in the host (typically the one you have open) is described as
  such and needs a second confirmation; the first click has no side effect at all.
- On success the row disappears everywhere and a toast reports the outcome **and the trash directory**
  (a Session whose log was already gone is reported as such, never as a move).

### Agent tools

| Tool | Arguments | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `session_delete` | `session_id` (required), `stop_activity` (default `true`), `force` (default `false`), `purge` (default `false`) | Moves the Session to the trash; `purge: true` deletes the bytes permanently instead. |
| `session_restore` | `session_id` (required) | Moves a trashed Session directory back to its original location. |

### Remote namespace

`remote.sessionDelete.delete({ sessionId, stopActivity?, force?, purge? })` and
`remote.sessionDelete.restore({ sessionId })` — the same operations the UI dialog uses.

### Restoring by hand

A trashed Session is an ordinary directory:

```bash
cat ~/.dsh/session-trash/<sessionId>-*/trash.json      # originalDirectory, title, cwd, sizes
mv ~/.dsh/session-trash/<sessionId>-*/  <originalDirectory>   # or use session_restore
```

The Workspace registry re-indexes stored headers on the next composition (a reload, or the next
launch), which is when the restored Session reappears in the list.

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `trashRoot` | `$DSH_HOME/session-trash` | Directory the Session directories are moved into; created on demand. Falls back to the persistence root's parent when `DSH_HOME` is unset. |

```yaml
- id: session-delete
  name: dsh-session-delete
  config:
    trashRoot: /Volumes/big/dsh-session-trash
```

## Semantics and limits

- **Deletion is a move, not a wipe.** Until you `purge`, the bytes are still on disk under
  `trashRoot`. The trash is never cleaned automatically.
- **A resident Session cannot be disposed by a third party.** The Session store owns its write
  handles and exposes no delete verb, so deleting a Session that a live Agent still holds would
  break that Agent's appends. The plugin refuses instead, and only proceeds on an explicit `force`
  (the log is gone; the in-memory copy becomes unusable).
- **Stopping is bounded.** The wait for running work to settle has a budget (15 s) and honours the
  call's `AbortSignal`; if the work outlives it, the call fails with `session/delete-active` and
  nothing is moved.
- **Only the Session directory is touched.** Attachments and spills are content-addressed global
  storage and are not collected, so they may leave orphaned blobs.
- **The search index needs no cleaning.** The session query index in the shipped composition is
  in-memory and drops vanished Sessions on its own.
- **Subagent Sessions are Sessions too.** They can be deleted with the same tool; the UI shows the
  removal through the same event.

Failure codes surfaced by the Remote namespace: `session/not-found`, `session/delete-live`,
`session/delete-active`, `session/delete-failed`, `session/restore-missing`,
`session/restore-conflict`.

## Development

```bash
node test/verify.mjs      # or: npm test
```

The self-test needs no DSH runtime, no network, and no dependencies: it builds a temporary session
root, drives the real trash logic through a fake host adapter, mounts the real plugin body against a
fake Cordis context, and checks the pieces that are easy to get wrong —

- the Typert manifest's shape *and* the strict codecs' boundary validation;
- the Gateway's fallback (“SRC”) discovery contract: Remote markers on the prototype plus
  signature-derived parameter names;
- trash, restore, purge, missing-directory, forced, refused, and aborted paths;
- tha

plugins.description: Traceable context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: hierarchical summaries, source retrieval and verified DM session rotation.
plugins.readme_text:
# Lossless Context for DeepSeek Harness

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) · [Security](SECURITY.md)

A **hierarchical context-compaction and retrieval backend** for DSH. Keep the native session history intact while building traceable summary nodes and allowing agents to retrieve their original supporting text.

## Features

- Uses the native DSH compaction transaction; the plugin does **not** replace or delete source session logs.
- Summarizes bounded, tool-call-safe event groups into a layered source DAG.
- Exposes `lcm_grep`, `lcm_describe`, `lcm_expand`, and `lcm_expand_query` for authorized session-local retrieval.
- Adapts headroom and output budgets to the **actual selected model**, with bounded retries for truncated summaries.
- Can prepare reusable summary leaves during idle maintenance without committing compaction.
- Optionally rotates eligible owner-verified Discord/Feishu direct-message sessions after a verified [Dream & Memory](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-memory-dreaming) handoff.

## Install and enable

Requires a compatible DSH host with its native session, token-meter and compaction services. See [package.json](package.json) for peer dependencies.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Kerberos255/dsh-lossless-context
```

Then open **Settings → Plugins → Lossless Context**, enable the backend, and choose the `dsh-lossless-context/agent` compaction backend for the agent preset that should use it. Installing the settings plugin alone does not guarantee that every preset uses this backend. Restart when changing plugin code or preset composition.

## How it works

```text
Native session events
  → native compaction selection
  → bounded summary leaves → merged summary DAG
  → native commit (only on success)
  → searchable index with references to source event IDs
```

The current session keeps its native record. Retrieval and expansion resolve back to original source events. Model/provider limits and existing policies control thresholds; unavailable model metadata causes a safe error instead of invented budgets.

## Safety, storage, and tests

The plugin stores **derived indexes** under DSH's data directory, not a second complete conversation history. Invalid, cancelled, oversized or truncated summaries are not committed. Private-channel auto-rotation requires verified owner/workspace bindings and completed Dream evidence; ordinary desktop/group/unverified sessions are not silently moved.

Run `npm test` for portable policy/regression tests. Real compaction and summary quality require an active model and DSH host. Example settings: [config.example.json](config.example.json). Historical notes: [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

Related: [Dream & Memory](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-memory-dreaming) · [Channel Core](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-channel-core).

MIT licensed. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

## Optional plugin diagnostics

The plugin optionally emits privacy-restricted operation and failure metadata to dsh-plugin-diagnostics. Diagnostics contain event type, status, fixed error code and elapsed time; conversation content and credentials are not logged. The diagnostics plugin is optional and does not change the host requirements.

plugins.description: Output house rules for every DeepSeek Harness agent: no check-mark or cross glyphs in replies or written files, and a light kaomoji habit in conversation. One global prompt section, so every preset, workspace and subagent obeys without a single preset edit.
plugins.readme_text:
# TastyLineOut

> Chinese documentation: [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)

Output house rules for every agent in a DeepSeek Harness profile, delivered as one global system
prompt section.

A profile-level plugin is mounted once by the roster, so the section it registers reaches every agent
that joins that standing scope: every preset, every workspace, every new conversation, and subagents
too. That is the whole point of doing it here rather than in fifteen preset files - a preset is a copy,
and a copy is a thing that drifts.

Three rules ship today.

1. **Symbol discipline** - no check-mark or cross judgement glyphs, in a reply or in a file the agent
   writes. Those glyphs pollute context and regression parameters, and a file written today is read
   back into context tomorrow, so the ban covers files and not just replies. Say it in words instead:
   pass / fail, works / broken, applied / not applied, yes / no.
2. **No emoji** - zero, in replies, in the agent's own thinking and in every file it writes. The ban
   is by block rather than by character list (pictographs, faces, transport, Miscellaneous Symbols,
   the geometric shapes that carry emoji presentation, plus the variation selector, the zero width
   joiner and the skin tone modifiers), because a list would need regenerating every Unicode release
   and would still be incomplete. Decoration is carved out - a heart, a note, a star, a sparkle, a
   flower - so the ban admits exactly the code points the loaded palette uses.
3. **Kaomoji habit** - Japanese-style emoticons in conversation and in the agent's own thinking, at a
   floor rather than as garnish: at least one per three sentences, and any reply of two sentences or
   more carries one. Aim above the floor. Faces rotate rather than repeat, and places that take none
   take none - a stack trace, a table of numbers, a serious conclusion.

## Install

```sh
# from GitHub (fastest path, no registry round trip)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Nesarf/TastyLineOut

# or from a clone
git clone https://github.com/Nesarf/TastyLineOut
dsh plugin --profile web add link:E:/TastyLineOut

# restart dsh web - plugin rows load at boot
```

Upgrading an installed copy needs `update`, not `add`: `add` reports "resolution step is skipped" and
leaves the lockfile on the old commit.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update TastyLineOut
```

## Configure

`$DSH_HOME/agent-house-rules.json` is read **on every model step**, not just at boot. Nothing is
required - with no file at all the three rules above are injected in English.

```json
{
  "locale": "zh",
  "bannedSymbols": "replace the whole ban with your own wording",
  "kaomoji": "",
  "append": "one more rule, added after the three above",
  "enabled": true
}
```

- `locale` selects a shipped rule set: `en` (default) or `zh`. A language tag such as `zh-CN` resolves
  to `zh`; an unknown locale falls back to `en`.
- `bannedSymbols` and `kaomoji` replace one rule each. An empty string disables that rule only.
- `rules: { "bannedSymbols": "...", "kaomoji": "..." }` replaces both at once.
- `append` is an extra block, placed last.
- `kaomojiLibrary` picks the palette: `true`/absent for the shipped library, `false` to leave it out,
  a path or a list of paths for your own. **A list replaces the shipped file** - name the shipped path
  too if you want both.
- `kaomojiLibraryMax` caps how many faces reach the prompt (default 140).
- `kaomojiLibraryCollapse: true` keeps each category on one line, which is cheaper.
- `enabled: false` empties the section, so nothing is injected.
- `selfCheck` (default true) and `selfCheckMax` (default 3) control the self-check below.
- `emojiCheck` (default true), `emojiCheckMax` (default 2) and `emojiAllowExtra` control the emoji
  ban and its notice budget.
- `selfCheckMode`: `"deny"` (default) names the judgement-mark family and lets the rest through;
  `"allow"` permits only plainly-textual blocks and refuses everything else. `allowExtra` names
  characters or code points the allow-list should also accept.

### The kaomoji library

`rules/kaomoji.json` ships 1150 faces across fourteen moods (cheerful, calm, wry, troubled, shy,
determined, puzzled, tired, affection, fullwidth and framed, with arms, decorated, blushing and
sweating, classic faces), each with the mood it carries and a short label. The library
is rendered into the prompt under the rules, so an agent has a palette to draw from instead of
reusing one face until it reads as a tic. Labels exist in both languages: `feel`/`use`/`label` are the
English rendering, `feelZh`/`useZh`/`labelZh` the Chinese one.

To grow it, either edit `rules/kaomoji.json` or point `kaomojiLibrary` at your own file with the same
shape:

```json
{
  "categories": [
    { "id": "mine", "label": "mine", "use": "when to reach for these",
      "faces": [{ "face": "(your face)", "feel": "what it signals" }] }
  ]
}
```

The prompt is not free, so the renderer takes faces in category order up to `kaomojiLibraryMax` and
counts the rest instead of printing them - a stable prefix, which also keeps the prompt prefix
cacheable. The file path is always named, so an agent that wants the remainder can read it. For scale:
the Chinese rendering of all 1150 faces is about 20 000 characters, which is exactly why the
ceiling exists: the default 140 carries about 2400 characters of palette.

### The self-check: rules with teeth

A prompt cannot notice anything, so the plugin also watches. It subscribes to `agent/pre-step`, which
fires before each model step, and looks at what the agent itself just said. When its own prose or
thinking carries a banned glyph, one notice goes in front of the next step: it names the code points
and asks for words instead. Nothing in history is edited.

- Judged: text and thinking the model authored. Not judged: tool results, file contents, fetched pages
  - the rule tells the agent not to relay those, it does not blame it for what a runner prints.
- Exempt: fenced and inline code, and the code-point references the rule itself asks for.
- Once per offending message, with a notice budget per session (three by default); past the budget,
  breaches are logged and nothing is injected.
- `selfCheck: false` turns it off; `selfCheckMax` sets the budget.

### What each judge does with an exception, and how the strict one seeds itself

- Allow mode derives its seed from the assembled rules and every loaded palette face, recomputed on
  each resolve. Without that it would refuse the very characters it ships - a strict judge that cannot
  read its own palette is not strict, it is broken. A face added at runtime is covered on the next step.
- `allowExtra` admits characters under allow mode, and withdraws them from the judgement list under
  deny mode. In deny mode that also rewrites the list the agent reads, so an exception is stated in the
  instruction rather than only applied in the checker.
- The judge travels with the rules rather than being frozen at registration, so switching mode, editing
  the palette or naming an exception lands on the next step of a session that is already running.

### Why editing that file needs no restart

The section registers `text` as a **function**. The prompt registry calls it while assembling the
prompt for each model step, so whatever the files say at that moment is what the agent is given.
Edit the config file or a library file and the next step of every running session - and every new
conversation - reads the new wording, with no host restart. Setting `enabled: false` likewise takes
effect from the next step.

The resolver stats the config file and each library file and only re-reads them when a stamp (size and
mtime) changes, so a step pays a few `stat` calls and nothing more.

Two layers apply, highest last: the packaged text in `src/index.js` for the chosen locale, then your
config file. `rules/<locale>.json` is **not** a third layer - see below. A config file that is missing
or malformed falls back to the packaged rules, and a malformed one is also warned about, because a
broken rules file must never keep a host from booting.

plugins.description: BharatCode and OpenAI-compatible provider setup alongside ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot subscriptions for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Provider Hub

A small installable DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds **Settings → Providers**:

- **BharatCode** preset with Qwen and DeepSeek model entries, API-key setup and live catalog discovery.
- **OpenAI-compatible endpoints**, using either Chat Completions or Responses, including localhost gateways.
- **ChatGPT (Codex), GitHub Copilot and other subscriptions**, by embedding the settings component from an installed `dsh-plugin-subscriptions` plugin. That plugin owns OAuth, refresh, quotas and subscription adapters.

The hub uses DSH's native `llm-pi-ai` adapter and authenticated settings/credentials Remote APIs. It does not fork Harness or copy the subscription plugin. API keys go into DSH's credential store, not the provider configuration or browser storage.

## Install

Use a DSH profile with the native `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` adapter enabled (standard profiles already supply it). Install the prebuilt GitHub package:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub
```

If subscriptions are not installed in the same profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-subscriptions
```

Restart DSH, then open **Settings → Providers**. For a web profile, substitute `web` for `desktop`. If the subscription plugin is already installed, keep that installation. A standalone archive is also available under [Releases](https://github.com/arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub/releases). Download it and pass its local `.tgz` path to the same `dsh plugin add` command.

## Use

**BharatCode:** select BharatCode, enter your key, optionally discover the account's current models, review model capacities, and save. Select the provider/model in the conversation model picker. The preset uses `https://bharatcode.ai/api/model/v1`; its initial model IDs and capacities are defaults from the local integration, not a guarantee of current account availability.

**Other endpoints:** select Add OpenAI-compatible, give it a unique route ID, enter the API base URL (include `/v1` or the gateway prefix), pick its API format and enter its key. Discover models or add IDs manually. Endpoints without discovery are supported through manual entries. A localhost server that accepts any key may use a placeholder key. Remote endpoints require HTTPS.

**Subscriptions:** expand Manage subscription sign-in to use the installed plugin's original controls. ChatGPT subscriptions authenticate as Codex; GitHub subscriptions mean GitHub Copilot. An ordinary GitHub account does not itself provide paid Copilot models. Subscription inference and subscription account limits remain the upstream plugin's responsibility.

Keys are never read back into the form. A blank key field keeps the stored key or the exported environment variable named in Key reference. The hub preserves route options such as headers, reasoning compatibility, retries and timeouts, and keeps existing per-model advanced options when a matching ID is retained. It uses the namespace's revision to reject stale saves. If settings save succeeds but credential storage fails, the page explains the partial save and asks you to retry the key.

Model discovery runs inside the host. Missing context/output capacities use editable estimates of 32,768/4,096 tokens. Review these before saving. Discovery replaces the draft model list; saved models are the IDs in that draft. The hub does not remove existing routes; use DSH's native Models settings for advanced editing/removal.

## Existing integrations considered

- [V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions](https://github.com/V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions): selected for subscription support; covers ChatGPT/Codex and Copilot plus Claude, Grok and Antigravity.
- [GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-subscriptions](https://github.com/GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-subscriptions): a broader subscription bridge; an alternative, not validated with this hub.
- [xxww0098/dsh-plugin-oauth-subs](https://github.com/xxww0098/dsh-plugin-oauth-subs): another subscription bridge using proxy routes; an alternative, not validated with this hub.

## Development and validation

```sh
git clone https://github.com/arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub.git
cd dsh-provider-hub
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm test
DSH_SOURCE=/path/to/deepseek-harness npm run test:composition
npm pack

# Optional test against the real subscription UI and Harness slot registry:
DSH_SOURCE=/path/to/deepseek-harness \
SUBSCRIPTIONS_SOURCE=/path/to/unpacked/dsh-plugin-subscriptions \
  npm run test:compatibility
```

`test:composition` requires a built Harness checkout and Node 24. It creates an isolated temporary profile and local OpenAI-compatible test server, then exercises the real Loader, settings revision/write path, native credential store, model discovery, model catalog and streamed inference. It does not touch the desktop profile or use real account credentials. `npm test` runs standalone unit/UI tests without a Harness installation. `test:compatibility` additionally mounts the real subscription component and uses the real Harness slot registry. Subscription support is tested with the existing 0.9.7 settings component contract; future upstream UI changes may require adaptation.

Validation covers an isolated Harness composition and the subscription plugin 0.9.7 UI contract. It does not establish live BharatCode, ChatGPT or Copilot account inference.

plugins.description: STRATA · 地层 — DSH UI 皮肤：工业网格 + 等高线背景，浅色纸面 / 深色终端两套底
plugins.readme_text:
# STRATA · DSH UI 皮肤

[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0969da?logo=github)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4d6bfe)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![test](https://github.com/tenebris173/dsh-skin-strata/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tenebris173/dsh-skin-strata/actions/workflows/test.yml)

> 罗德岛终端风格 · 直角切角 · 黑色发丝线 · 黄黑警示条 · DIN 技术字

按 **`dsh.ecosystem.ui-skin-loader/v1`** 公约实现的 DSH 皮肤包。装好后出现在
**设置 → 皮肤** 的卡片墙里，与其它皮肤并列，一键切换。

![外观矩阵](preview/strata-matrix.png)

## 运行模式：有控制台托管，没控制台自立

| 场景 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| **装了皮肤控制台** | 登记托管：出现在 **设置 → 皮肤管理** 卡片墙里，由控制台负责互斥切换 / 持久化 / 故障隔离 |
| **没装控制台** | 等待 3 秒宽限后进入**自立模式**：自动应用外观，并在「设置 → STRATA」里给出开关与全部调节项 |

> **不会误判**：皮肤用运行时提供的 `ctx.inject(["uiSkinLoader"], cb)` **显式等待**控制台服务出现，
> 而不是在加载瞬间"看一眼有没有"。所以即使控制台比皮肤晚一步就绪，也仍然会正常登记（这是上一版踩过的坑）。

### 对控制台 / 脚本的接口

无论哪种模式，皮肤都暴露一个统一入口：

```js
window.__dshSkins["skins.strata"]
// { mode: "console" | "standalone", skinId, version,
//   isActive(), activate(), deactivate(), getSettings(), setSettings(patch) }
```

### 「原生」选项

设置面板里的 **「皮肤」下拉** 第一项是 **原生（默认观感）** —— 选中即还原默认皮肤：

- 有控制台时：调用控制台的 `switchTo("default")`（与控制台自己的"还原默认观感"同一路径），持久化归控制台；
- 自立模式时：直接关掉自己（`enabled=false`），立即卸下并**长期保持原生**，随时可再从下拉里选回本皮肤。

控制台是**可选**的第三方插件，不随本包分发。

## 这是一个 DSH 插件

本仓库是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的插件（皮肤类）。
按官方 README「Community and support」一节的要求，仓库已打上
[`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic，便于在
[github.com/topics/dsh-plugin](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) 被发现；
`package.json` 的 `keywords` 与 `dsh.skin.tags` 里同样带 `dsh-plugin`。

三种安装方式，任选其一：

| 方式 | 命令 / 操作 |
| --- | --- |
| git（无需下载包） | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/tenebris173/dsh-skin-strata` |
| 美化包 | 从 Releases 下 `STRATA-UI-*.zip`，双击 `安装STRATA皮肤.cmd` |
| 本地源码 | 见下方「安装 → B. 从源码装」 |

> 装完**必须重启 DSH**（插件包只在启动时进启动图），随后在 **设置 → 皮肤** 里一键切换。

## 外观

| 项 | 选项 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 外观 | 跟随应用 / 纸面（亮）/ 终端（暗） | 跟随应用 |
| 强调色 | 警示黄 / 工程橙 / 信号青 | 警示黄 |
| 圆角 | 直角 0px / 工作台 6px / 圆润 12px | 直角 |
| 纹理 | 全屏细网格 + 扫描线 + 四角登记标记 | 开 |
| 硬投影 | 浮窗错位实心影 + 按钮按压位移 | 开 |
| DIN 技术字 | 拉丁文用 Bahnschrift（中文回落雅黑） | 开 |

3 × 3 × 3 × 2 × 2 × 2 = **216 种组合**，改档即时生效并跨重启保留
（皮肤自治：`localStorage`，键 `dsh.skin.strata.preferences.v1`）。

**跟随应用**：读 `ctx.theme.getTheme().preference`，为 `system` 时用 `prefers-color-scheme`
判定；1s 轮询 + `matchMedia` 监听，应用换主题时自动重算。

## 两套底

| | 纸面（Paper · 亮） | 终端（Terminal · 暗） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 底 / 面板 / 卡片 | `#f4f5f7` / `#ffffff` / `#ffffff` | `#0d1012` / `#121618` / `#171c1f` |
| 发丝线 | 黑 18–60% | 冷白 15–60% |
| 实心块（徽标 / 主按钮 / DONE 章） | 黑底白字 | **反相**：冷白底深字 |
| 代码 token | `#1d3f63` `#7a4b12` `#b5342a` | `#8ab7ea` `#e0a45c` `#ff9a8a` |
| 警示黄 | `#ffd100` | `#ffd100` |

## 安装

### A. 用打包好的美化包（推荐给最终用户）

下载 release 里的 `STRATA-UI-*.zip`，解压后双击 `安装STRATA皮肤.cmd`。脚本会找到本机 DSH
（优先用你**正在运行**的那个），用官方途径装进 `desktop` profile，并把 `activeSkin` 切到本皮肤。

### B. 从源码装（开发）

```powershell
# 应用目录（默认装在当前用户的 LocalAppData 下；装在 Program Files 时改成对应路径）
$app = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness"
$cli = "$app\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop-host\lib\cli.js"

# 以软链方式安装（改代码刷新即生效）
& "$app\DeepSeek Harness.exe" $cli plugin --profile desktop add "<本仓库绝对路径>"

# 卸载
& "$app\DeepSeek Harness.exe" $cli plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-skin-strata
```

装完**必须重启 DSH**（新增插件包只在启动时进启动图）。切换皮肤也可以直接在
**设置 → 皮肤** 里点，不必手改配置。

## 设计语言

1. **纸面/终端，不是"深色科幻"** —— 层级只靠 1px 线与明度差，零阴影、零光晕、零圆角。
2. **切角而非圆角** —— `border-radius: 0`；面板头是黑底白字条 + 黄色 ▶；浮窗用错位实心影。
3. **警示黄只给四处** —— 当前 / 可点 / 运行中 / 焦点；其余全部黑白灰。
4. **DIN 技术字 + 字距** —— 拉丁文 Bahnschrift 大写标签；中文雅黑托底；数字等宽。

## 实现要点

- **观感承载**：`theme.overrideTokens()` 覆盖宿主公开 token —— `--dsw-alias-*`(107)、
  `--dsw-specific-*`(11)、`--dsw-menu-*`、`--dsw-linear-*`、`--dsw-radius-*`（直角 0）、
  `--dsw-static-neutral(-bluish)-*` 中性灰阶、`--dsw-font-family` / `--ds-font-family-code`。
- **驱动宿主亮暗开关**：`body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 由皮肤按有效底置位 / 摘除 —— 否则
  `--dsw-specific-*` 这类"只在 scheme 分支里有定义"的表面会落在错误的一档（实测过：
  纸面模式下输入框仍是深色）。
- **浮层实色兜底**：`[role="dialog"] / [aria-modal] / [role="menu|listbox|tooltip"]`
  强制实色 + 直角（STRATA 的表面本就是实心的，弹窗天然不透出正文）。
- **装饰层**：注入 7 个自有节点（网格、扫描线、左缘警示条、四角登记标记），
  `pointer-events:none` + `z-index:1`（低于菜单 100 / 弹窗 1000），退出时整体移除。
- **生命周期**（公约 §4.3 / R8）：activate 的每项副作用都登记 disposer，teardown 幂等；
  `deactivate` / `skinCtx.signal` abort / fiber 意外 dispose 三路汇合，退出后 token 与节点全部还原。
- **主题注册兜底**：重复 id 时改用带序号的 id，皮肤重载后不会整次回滚成默认。
- **设置面板**：经 `settings.section` 席位注册 React 组件，只在皮肤激活时出现。

## 自测

| 脚本 | 覆盖 | 断言 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tests/browser-smoke.mjs` | 控制台路径：登记载荷 / 激活副作用 / **真实 CSS 层叠** / teardown | 32 |
| `tests/console-wait.mjs` | 控制台迟到 1 秒（不许误判自立）/ 始终不出现（自立 + 能回原生） | 18 |
| `tests/skin-selector.mjs` | 「皮肤」选择器：控制台模式走 switchTo / 自立模式走开关自己 | 9 |
| `tests/contrast.mjs` | **每个强调色 × 每种底**：文字/标签对比度 ≥4.5:1，亮底派生深档 | 25 |
| `tests/dependency-check.mjs` | 宿主半依赖自检 | 6 |

合计 **90 项断言**。

## 目录

```
lib/index.js          宿主半（空 apply：观感全在 client 半）
lib/client.js         皮肤本体（登记 / token 表 / 两套底 / 外观面板 / 生命周期）
cordis.patch.yml      bundle patch（row id = 设置命名空间）
install/              一键安装 / 卸载脚本（美化包同款）
preview/              外观矩阵图 + 卡片预览 SVG
tests/browser-smoke.mjs
```

## 更新记录

见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 许可

MIT。

plugins.description: Interactive behavioral shaping for a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) session: rewrite the model-visible conversation history in place - edit a reply or its reasoning chain, delete a message, undo any rewrite, with an audit trail. Continuation of @wasd258/dsh-context-surgery (MIT, (c) 2026 WASD258-jpg).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-shaping

Interactive **behavioral shaping** for a running DeepSeek Harness (DSH) session: rewriting its **model-visible conversation history** in place.

Edit a reply and its reasoning chain separately, delete a message, replace a whole exchange — the model's next request reads the shaped history as if it had always been that way, so the conversation continues along the shape you set. Each rewrite shadows the old nodes instead of erasing them, so the original text stays in the append-only event log, every rewrite is recorded in an audit trail, and rewrites can be undone.

> Community plugin — not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. It is a continuation of `@wasd258/dsh-context-surgery` 0.1.0–0.1.2 (© 2026 WASD258-jpg, MIT); see [License & attribution](#license--attribution).

Version 0.4.0 · MIT · Node.js >= 22.19.0 · requires a DSH web profile

## Requirements

- DSH with the **web profile** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`): the browser half injects the per-message buttons.
- Node.js >= 22.19.0.
- A **running top-level session** to rewrite. Subagents are refused for mutating operations.

## Install

### Plugin Manager (recommended)

Open the plugins page in DSH (Plugin Manager) and install this bundle — `plugin_manager`'s `install_bundle` installs the package and selects the bundle for you. The card shows the localized title and description from this package: **Context Shaping** (English, `locale/en.json`) / **上下文塑形** (Chinese, `locale/zh.json`).

### Manual

Run pnpm **inside the profile directory** (the DSH app ships one at `resources/runtime/pnpm/bin/pnpm.cjs` if you have none on `PATH`):

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>          # desktop for the desktop app, web for `dsh web`
pnpm add github:zeranhub/dsh-context-shaping
```

That is what `install_bundle` does: the package lands in the **profile's own** `node_modules`, and the profile manifest records it as a dependency:

```json
{
  "name": "dsh-profile-desktop",
  "private": true,
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-context-shaping": "github:zeranhub/dsh-context-shaping"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "dsh-context-shaping"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

If `dsh-context-shaping` is not in `dsh.profile.bundles` after the install, add it — that list is what inserts the plugin row.

> **A copy next to the profile is not enough.** Dropping the package into `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules` (the parent directory) and only editing `dsh.profile.bundles` loads nothing: DSH resolves a bundle row through the profile's own dependency tree, so the package must be in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules` and declared in that manifest's `dependencies`.

On Windows `~/.dsh` is `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh` (or `$DSH_HOME`).

Restart DSH and reload the page so the client module (`lib/client.js`) is loaded too — see [Notes](#notes).

> A bundle that does not declare `dsh.bundle.patch` is **skipped** by DSH and reported in `skippedBundles` at startup, so the plugin never loads even though it is listed. This package declares `"dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" } }`; that patch is what inserts the plugin row into the composition.

### Upgrading from 0.1.x

Two renames happened on the way here: 0.2.0 moved the scoped upstream package `@wasd258/dsh-context-surgery` to the unscoped `dsh-context-surgery` and added the `dsh.bundle.patch` declaration that 0.1.x lacked, and **0.4.0 renamed the project again, to `dsh-context-shaping`**. To migrate:

1. remove the old entry from `dsh.profile.bundles` in your profile manifest and delete the old module directory — `@wasd258/dsh-context-surgery` (0.1.x) and/or `dsh-context-surgery` (0.2.0/0.3.0);
2. install this package as above, with `dsh-context-shaping` in the bundle list;
3. restart DSH.

Leaving the old entry in place is harmless but pointless — DSH skips it and prints a line about it at startup. Rewrite records held in memory are per-process; after a restart `/shape history` still lists rewrites recovered from the durable log, without their original timestamps.

## Usage

### Per-message buttons (web GUI)

The plugin registers into the `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` slot (`order: 20`), so each assistant message gets an action row:

| Button | Action |
|---|---|
| ✏️ | Rewrite this reply. Opens an inline text box prefilled with the current reply text; **Save** → "Reply rewritten ✓". The reasoning chain and tool calls are kept. |
| 💡 | Rewrite this reasoning chain. Shown only when the message actually has a reasoning block; saving an empty text removes it. |
| ↩️ | Restore the content this rewrite shadowed. Shown only on rewrite nodes. |
| 🗑️ | Delete this message. Asks for confirmation first; the message disappears from the model's view. |
| badge | `rewritten` marks a node that is itself a rewrite; its original text is still in the event log. |

Button labels and tooltips follow the browser language (`zh*` → Chinese, otherwise English).

The host composes the row as `[clock] copy · extraActions · branch`, and our slot's entry is that `extraActions` — so these buttons sit **immediately to the right of the copy icon**.

### Edit your own message (web GUI)

The AI's buttons are per-message; your own messages have no action row a plugin can extend in this DSH build (see [Notes](#notes)). Instead the plugin adds a small ✏️ **Edit mine** control in the composer's tool row (`conversation.input.left`), which opens a full-width editor above the card (`conversation.input.dock`):

1. click **Edit mine** — it loads your most recent own message (injected `user/message` context is skipped);
2. change the text and press **Save**;
3. the message is rewritten in the model-visible history — **nothing is sent**, no new turn starts, and the next model request reads the edited text.

### `/shape` command

`/shape` on its own (or `/shape list`) prints the current model-visible nodes — the last 10, as `[seq] AI|TOOL|YOU <preview>`, with rewritten nodes marked — followed by the usage list.

| Command | Effect |
|---|---|
| `/shape`, `/shape list`, `ls`, `?` | List the current model-visible nodes (last 10) with `seq`, role badge and a 120-character preview. |
| `/shape show <seq>` | Print one node's full reply and reasoning chain (and whether it carries tool blocks). |
| `/shape edit <seq> <text>` | Rewrite the reply text only; reasoning chain and tool calls are kept. |
| `/shape think <seq> <text>` | Rewrite the reasoning chain only; the reply text is kept. |
| `/shape clear-think <seq>` | Remove the reasoning chain. |
| `/shape rewrite <seq> <user\|assistant> <text>` | Rewrite the whole node as plain text (`part=all`). This is the only command that may change a node's role. |
| `/shape delete <seq>` | Remove the node from the model's view. |
| `/shape replace <start> <end> <user\|assistant> <text>` | Replace the contiguous range `start..end` (inclusive, current surface order) with one message. |
| `/shape history [n]` (alias `log`) | Rewrite audit trail, newest first (default 10, clamped to 1–50). |
| `/shape undo [n]` (alias `restore`) | Restore the n-th most recent rewrite (default 1). |

`<text>` is taken verbatim from the command line, spaces included; `seq` arguments must be integers. Failures are reported as `操作失败：<reason>` and unknown subcommands as `未知子命令：<op>` — command output, error strings and audit lines are in Chinese in 0.2.0.

### Model tools

| Tool | Parameters | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `shape_list` | `limit?` | List surface nodes in order (or the last N) with `seq`, `role`, `text`. Read-only. |
| `shape_edit` | `seq`, `text`, `part?` (`reply`/`thinking`/`all`), `role?` | `part` defaults to `reply`; `role` is only honored with `part=all`. |
| `shape_delete` | `seq` | Shadow one node with an empty assistant message. |
| `shape_replace` | `start`, `end`, `role`, `text` | Both endpoints inclusive and must be current surface nodes. |
| `shape_history` | `limit?` | Read the rewrite audit trail. Read-only. |
| `shape_restore` | `seq` **or** `index` | Undo the rewrite at `seq`, or the `index`-th most recent rewrite (1 = most recent). |

All six are ref

# dsh-learning-gap-check — Competency gap and development plan register check

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-learning-gap-check` reads one competency-gap and development-plan register — the employee header plus one row per competency — and checks that register's own arithmetic and closure: that each gap names its position and competency, that the recorded levels parse as numbers, that the gap equals the required level minus the actual level, that a gap beyond your configured threshold carries a development action, that an action names an owner and a due date, that the completion date is not later than the deadline, and that the action status comes from your own vocabulary.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-learning-gap-check: real output over its LG-002 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-learning-gap-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-learning-gap-check-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `LG-002` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A row carries the competency but leaves the position blank. | `LG-001` reports a row only when `position` and `competency` are both empty; one of the two filled is enough. It checks that the row names a post and a competency, not whether the competency requirement for that post is reasonable or complete. |
| Our levels are written as words (`熟练`, `掌握`) or as letters (`A`/`B`/`C`) — what happens? | `LG-002` reads `actualLevel` and requires it to parse as a number, so a level written as a word or a letter is reported as unparseable. The plugin ships no competency scale: convert the register to a numeric scale, or disable `LG-002` together with `LG-003`. Parseability is all it checks — whether the assessment was objective or accurate is not judged. |
| The gap column says `3`, but required `4` minus actual `2` is `2` — does that get caught? | `LG-003` recomputes `requiredLevel − actualLevel` with a tolerance of `0` and reports the row whose stored `gapLevel` disagrees. It runs only when all three columns hold parseable numbers; if one is missing the rule goes to `skipped`. A negative gap is reported as it stands, because the columns may have been transposed, and the rule does not decide how large a gap counts as a problem. |
| A row records a development action but no owner and no due date. | `LG-005` requires `owner` and `dueAt` on every row whose `action` is filled, and reports the row missing either one. It checks that the two fields are recorded; it does not judge whether the action is effective or the deadline reasonable. |
| A row's completion date is later than its due date, or the two columns were filled in the wrong order. | `LG-006` compares `dueAt` with `completedAt` on every row and reports the row when the due date falls before the completion date. The pack states its limit in its own words: it compares only the order of the two dates and does not decide whether the work was really completed on schedule. A date it cannot parse is reported in its own right instead of being passed over. |
| `LG-004` and `LG-007` never report anything — does that mean my register passed them? | No: both rules report themselves in `skipped`. `LG-004` ships with `threshold: 0`, which means unconfigured — set the gap size at which a development action becomes mandatory. `LG-007` ships with an empty status vocabulary — fill it from your institution's own wording. Once configured, `LG-004` checks only that the action column is filled and `LG-007` only that the status value is in your vocabulary; neither judges whether the action was really carried out. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《质量管理 能力管理和人员发展指南》 | GB/T 19025—2023（质量管理 能力管理和人员发展指南；2023-03-17 发布并实施；归口全国质量管理和质量保证标准化技术委员会；条号本次未取得） | LG-001, LG-002, LG-003, LG-005, LG-006 |
| 本机构培训与发展管理口径（本机构配置） | 无统一标准（本条依据为本机构配置的差距阈值） | LG-004 |
| 本机构培训与发展管理口径（本机构配置） | 无统一标准（本条依据为本机构配置的状态口径） | LG-007 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **能力差距与培养计划台账** for arithmetic and closure — that each gap names its
position and competency, that the two level columns parse as numbers, that the gap equals required minus actual,
that a gap beyond your threshold carries a development action, that an action names an owner and a due date, that
the completion date is not later than the deadline, and that the action status comes from your vocabulary. It does
**not** decide whether an employee is competent, whether an assessment was objective, whether a development action
worked, or whether someone should be reassigned or dismissed.

> ### ⚠️ What this plugin deliberately leaves out
>
> **It ships no competency scale, and it assumes the levels are numbers.** `LG-002` and `LG-003` read three
> numeric columns and check the arithmetic between them. A register using letter grades (`A`/`B`/`C`) or words
> (`熟练`/`掌握`) is **reported as unparseable**, because comparing such levels is a modelling decision the
> plugin will not make for you. Convert the scale, or disable those rules.
>
> **It ships no threshold for "big enough to need action".** How much of a gap obliges a development action is
> the institution's talent-management call — some units require one for any shortfall, others tolerate a step —
> so `LG-004`'s threshold starts at `0` and the rule reports itself in `skipped` until you set it.
>
> **The status vocabulary ships empty** for the same reason. And the date rule checks only that the deadline
> does not precede the completion date, which is a data-entry property: **it does not judge whether the work was
> done late.**
>
> **Every `excerpt` in the rule pack says, in so many words, that the clause text was not obtained.** The regime
> lives in GB/T 19025 (identical to ISO 10015) and each institution's qualification and training rules. The
> verification pass could not retrieve verbatim clause text, so the pack states the gap in the `excerpt` field
> itself and keeps every rule at `warn` or `info`. **When the texts are in hand, replace each `excerpt` with the
> real clause and raise `kind` to `direct`.**

|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for a department's plan use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `learning_gap_check` tool. It reads one gap-and-plan register — the employee header plus one row per
competency — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LG-001` | the position and competency are recorded | warn | principle |
| `LG-002` | the actual level parses as a number | warn | principle |
| `LG-003` | the gap equals required minus actual | warn | principle |
| `LG-004` | a gap beyond your threshold carries an action (off by default) | info | local |
| `LG-005` | an action names an owner and a due date | warn | principle |
| `LG-006` | the deadline does not precede the completion date | warn | principle |
| `LG-007` | the status comes from your vocabulary (off by default) | info | local |

## Install

```sh

dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-learning-gap-check'
```

| `disabledRules` | string[] | `[]` | Rule ids to stop running; each appears in `skipped` |
| `onlyRules` | string[] | `[]` | Run only these rule ids; empty runs every rule |
| `skipNotes` | string | `""` | Note appended to every `ski
