# dsh-contract-stance — Contract clause stance register completeness and self-consistency check

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-contract-stance` reads one clause-stance register — the contract header plus one row per clause — and checks that register's own completeness and self-consistency: that each clause's text is recorded, that your stance comes from your own vocabulary, that the risk grade does too, that a must-have clause records both a fallback position and an owner, that clause numbers are unique, that the register names the contract and your side, and that no unreplaced placeholder survives in the clause text.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-contract-stance: real output over its CS-001 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-contract-stance/main/docs/assets/dsh-contract-stance-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `CS-001` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A clause row carries a topic, but the clause-text column is blank. Is that reported? | Yes. `CS-001` requires the `text` column on every row: without the wording, a stance cannot be checked against what it is a stance on. The rule checks only that the wording is recorded — it does not judge whether the clause should be accepted or whether it carries legal risk. |
| The stance and the risk grade are both filled in, yet every row comes back as `skipped`. Why? | Both value lists ship empty. `CS-002` accepts a stance only from the list configured for it, and `CS-003` does the same for the risk grade; with no list configured neither rule can run, so each reports itself in `skipped` rather than passing quietly. `CS-002` checks only that the value is on your list, not that the stance is appropriate; `CS-003` checks only that the grade is on your list, not how high the actual risk of that clause is. |
| A clause is marked must-have, but nobody wrote how far we can concede or who decides. | `CS-004` reads the register's own must-have column: for a row marked `是`, `Y`, `yes`, `true`, `必保` or `√` (the values set by `conditionValues`) it requires both the `fallback` and the `owner` column to be filled. It checks only that those two are filled, not whether the fallback is reasonable; which clauses count as must-have depends entirely on the project, and the rule never decides that. |
| The same clause number appears on two rows, one per negotiating draft. Is that a finding? | `CS-005` reports a repeated clause number, comparing with whitespace ignored. A repeated number makes it impossible to point at one clause precisely. One clause appearing once per draft is a normal shape: distinguish it in the version column instead of reusing the number. No clause requires clause numbers to be unique — uniqueness is what makes the register referable. |
| The header does not say which contract this is, nor which side we are. | `CS-006` requires the material's header to state `contractName` and `party`: without those two, a stance cannot be traced to a specific transaction and party. If your form carries a version column for negotiating drafts, add it to that rule's `fields`. The rule only checks that the header declares those two. |
| The clause text was copied straight from a model form and still contains 【】 or TBD. | `CS-007` reports clause text that still holds any of its placeholder terms — `【`, `】`, `{{`, `}}`, `XXX`, `xxx`, `待填`, `待补充`, `TBD`, `todo`, `示例` — which can be adjusted to your own template. Referring to a model form is allowed; the danger is that a template placeholder is read as wording already reviewed. The rule only looks for those terms in the `text` column, not at the clause itself. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《中华人民共和国民法典》 | 现行版本与条号本次未核实 | CS-001, CS-002, CS-003, CS-004, CS-005, CS-006, CS-007 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **合同条款立场台账** for what a register can be held to — that each clause's
text is recorded, that your stance comes from your vocabulary, that the risk grade does too, that a must-have
clause records both a fallback position and an owner, that clause numbers are unique, that the register names
the contract and your side, and that no placeholder survives. It does **not** decide whether a clause should be
accepted, whether a risk is bearable, whether to sign, or whether a negotiating strategy is sound. **Those
depend on the deal, the counterparty's leverage and your own risk appetite.**

> ### ⚠️ What the citation rests on — and one thing this plugin must never be given
>
> **《中华人民共和国民法典》was obtained and read verbatim**, and `rules/evidence/clause-verification.md`
> records what was quoted: article 465 (a contract lawfully formed is protected by law), article 470 (contract
> content **一般包括** the parties, subject matter, quantity, quality, price, performance terms and liability for
> breach), article 509, article 577 (the consequences of breach) and article 584 (damages include expected
> profits but are capped by **foreseeability**).
>
> **The contract part does not regulate a negotiation register.** It governs formation, validity, performance and
> liability; the register's columns come from your enterprise's own contract management rules. So the `excerpt`
> fields still say "本次未取得" and every rule stays `warn` or `info`: **"this column is blank" must not be read
> as "this breaches the Civil Code".** Note also that article 470 says **一般包括**, not 应当包括 — one more
> reason `CS-001` does not claim a direct obligation.
>
> ⚠️ **Do not add a limitation-period rule to this plugin.** The Code *does* fix numbers — article 188 sets a
> three-year limitation (twenty years at the outside) and article 203 rolls a period forward off a public
> holiday — which makes "just compare the dates" look tempting. It is not workable here: the period runs from
> **when the creditor knew or ought to have known** of the harm and the debtor, a finding of fact the register
> does not record; the period is also subject to suspension (article 194) and interruption (article 195), and
> article 196 lists claims the limitation does not apply to at all. A date-arithmetic rule would dress a factual
> finding up as a calculation, which is precisely the over-claim this family avoids.
>
> **No judgement about the substance of a clause is made anywhere in this plugin.** It reads your own columns
> and checks only that they are filled and drawn from your vocabulary. Two vocabularies ship **empty** — the
> stance list (`CS-002`) and the risk grades (`CS-003`) — so with nothing configured those rules report
> themselves in `skipped` rather than passing quietly.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for a full contract use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `contract_stance` tool. It reads one clause-position register — the contract header plus one row
per clause — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CS-001` | every clause's text is recorded | warn | principle |
| `CS-002` | the stance comes from your vocabulary (off by default) | info | principle |
| `CS-003` | the risk grade comes from your vocabulary (off by default) | info | direct |
| `CS-004` | a must-have clause records a fallback and an owner | warn | direct |
| `CS-005` | clause numbers are unique | warn | principle |
| `CS-006` | the register names the contract and your side | warn | direct |
| `CS-007` | the clause text holds no unreplaced placeholder | warn | principle |

# dsh-aqua-input-check — Aquaculture input register completeness and withdrawal-period date check

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-aqua-input-check` reads one aquaculture input register — the farm header plus one row per input record — and checks that register's own completeness and date arithmetic: that each record names its pond and species, that a named input records its quantity and use date, that the use date is not in the future, that harvesting respects the withdrawal period the record itself states, that a stocking record carries its source and quarantine certificate number, that the input type comes from your configured vocabulary, and that batch numbers are unique.
It does not decide whether farming practice is compliant, whether the product is safe to eat, whether medication was appropriate, or whether a penalty applies.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-aqua-input-check: real output over its AQ-003 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-aqua-input-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-aqua-input-check-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `AQ-003` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A record names the input but leaves the pond and the species column empty. | `AQ-001` requires at least one of `pondNo` and `species` on every record. It only checks that one of the two is filled in, and does not judge whether that input is suitable for that species. |
| The input name is there, but the quantity and the use date are blank. | `AQ-002` asks for `inputQty` and `usedAt` whenever `inputName` is filled in. It checks that the fields are recorded, not that the dosage is appropriate or that the medication suits the disease. |
| The use date is written as `15/03/2026`, and one row carries next month's date. | `AQ-003` accepts `2026-03-15` and `2026-03-15 09:30`; a `usedAt` it cannot parse is reported as unparseable, and one later than the check date is reported as a future date. It does not touch the withdrawal period — the pack ships no withdrawal days at all. |
| We treated on 1 June with 20 withdrawal days recorded and harvested on 15 June. Is that caught? | Yes. `AQ-004` compares `usedAt`, `harvestAt` and the record's own `withdrawalDays`, and reports the row as short by the difference. A finding means "by the withdrawal period you recorded, harvest came early" — not that the product is unsafe, which needs a residue test this plugin cannot see. If those three fields are not all filled and parseable, the rule reports `skipped` instead of assuming a period. |
| The input type we use is not in the list — nothing is reported. | `AQ-006` reports `skipped` because the pack ships no input-type vocabulary: `values` is empty until you configure one. Once set, the rule checks that the stored `inputType` is one of your values. It does not judge whether that input may lawfully be used — that needs the prohibited-drug list and the product's approval number. |
| The same batch number appears in two rows. | `AQ-007` reports the repeat and names both rows. | 本机构养殖生产管理口径（本机构配置） | 无统一标准（本条依据为本机构配置的类型口径） | AQ-006 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks an **水产养殖投入品记录** for completeness and date arithmetic — that each record

future, that harvesting respects the withdrawal period the record states, that stocking records its source and

**not** decide whether farming practice is compliant, whether the product is safe to eat, whether medication was
appropriate, or whether a penalty applies.

> ### ⚠️ What this plugin deliberately does not know
>
> **It ships no withdrawal periods.** `AQ-004` checks that the harvest date is at least as many days after the use
> date as **the record's own withdrawal-period column says**. So a finding means "**by the withdrawal period you
> recorded, harvest came N days early**" — never "this product is unsafe". Residue safety needs a test result,
> which this plugin cannot see. A record with no harvest date reports itself in `skipped` rather than assuming a
> period.
>
> **It ships no list of permitted or prohibited inputs.** `AQ-006` checks that the input type is one you
> configured; whether a product may lawfully be used requires the prohibited-drug list and the product's approval
> number, and this plugin does not go there.
>
> **Every `excerpt` in the rule pack says, in so many words, that the clause text was not obtained.** The regime
> lives in 《水产养殖质量安全管理规定》, NY 5361, NY/T 755 and GB 13078. The verification pass could not

> to `direct`.**

# dsh-protest-deadline — Query and complaint register date and deadline check

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-protest-deadline` reads one query-and-complaint register (质疑与投诉台账) — the project header plus one row per query — and checks what such a register can be held to mechanically: that the date the query was raised or the date it was answered is recorded, that the dates parse and follow one another, that the reply falls inside the deadline the register itself states, that every status comes from your own vocabulary, that the query numbers are unique, and that the header names the procurement project.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-protest-deadline: real output over its PD-002 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-protest-deadline/main/docs/assets/dsh-protest-deadline-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `PD-002` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A row leaves both the date the query was raised and the date it was answered blank. Is that reported? | Yes. `PD-001` requires at least one of `raisedAt` and `replyAt` on every row and reports the row where both are empty. It checks only that one of the two is filled, not whether the query was raised inside the legal period: that needs the date the supplier knew of the harm, the service date and a working-day count a register usually does not carry. |
| The reply date is written earlier than the raise date. Is that caught? | `PD-002` compares the raise date with the reply date row by row and reports `raisedAt` when it is later than `replyAt`; the same day counts as not later. A value it cannot parse — `2026年3月15日`, say, where `2026-03-15`, `2026/3/15` or `2026-03-15 09:30` would be read — is reported on that row instead of being passed over quietly. The rule only orders the two dates the register carries. |
| Our reply went out after the reply deadline recorded in the register. Was it late? | `PD-003` hard-codes no day count and cannot say “late”: it compares the actual reply date with the deadline written in the register's own `replyDueAt` column, so a finding means “this disagrees with the deadline you recorded”. With that column empty there is nothing to compare against and the rule reports itself in `skipped`, rather than assuming a period. |
| The status column says 已答复, yet nothing came back for it. Why? | `PD-005` compares the status with the vocabulary you configure, and `values` ships empty, so as delivered the rule reports itself in `skipped` — the choice of values belongs to your institution, not to the engine — instead of passing silently. Fill `values` with your own list (待答复, 已答复, 已投诉, 已撤回, …) and any value not on it is reported row by row. It checks that the value is on the list, never how the query should be handled. |
| The header names the project but carries no header-level raise date. Is something missing? | No. `PD-006` checks the header for the procurement project only: its `fields` default to `[project]`, because the raise date is normally a per-row column. If your form does state it in the header, the rule's own note says to set `fields` to `[project, raisedAt]`. A missing project is reported against the header, not against a row. |
| The same query number appears on two rows. | `PD-007` reports the second row and names the first, comparing the numbers with whitespace ignored. A repeat usually means the same query was registered twice or a number was copied — telling those apart is a human call. If the register carries no number column, the rule reports that it does not apply rather than passing. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《政府采购质疑和投诉办法》 | 财政部令第94号（2017 年 12 月 26 日公布，自 2018 年 3 月 1 日起施行；六章四十五条。⚠️ 本令第四十五条同时废止财政部令第20号《政府采购供应商投诉处理办法》） | PD-001, PD-002, PD-003, PD-004, PD-005, PD-006, PD-007 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **质疑与投诉台账** for what a register can be held to mechanically — that
the key dates are recorded, that they parse and follow one another, that a reply falls inside the deadline
the register itself states, that statuses come from your vocabulary, and that query numbers are unique. It
does **not** decide whether a query was filed in time, whether it should be accepted, or whether it should
be rejected. **Those calls need the purchaser or the finance department, the service dates, and a
working-day basis that a ledger usually does not record.**

> ### ⚠️ What the citation rests on
>
> **《政府采购质疑和投诉办法》(财政部令第94号) was obtained and read verbatim** — the whole text, six chapters
> and forty-five articles — and `rules/evidence/clause-verification.md` records what was quoted:
> article 10 (question within **7 working days**), article 13 (reply within **7 working days**), article 17
> (complaint within 15 working days **after the reply period expires**), article 21 (5 and 8 working days),
> article 26 (30 working days) and **article 42**, which fixes two calculation rules — 「期间开始之日，
> 不计算在期间内」 and a roll-over when the final day is a holiday. Article 45 also **repealed**
> 财政部令第20号, so this pack never cites it.
>
> **The rule `excerpt` fields still say "本次未取得", and every rule remains `warn` or `info`.** What this
> plugin checks is an internal register's dates and columns; the measure governs how purchasers and finance
> departments behave. Calling a blank column a `direct` breach of "shall reply within 7 working days" would
> dress a record-keeping gap up as a regulatory one. The government procurement law itself was not obtained.
>
> **This plugin hard-codes no day count, and the text now proves why.** The periods run in **working days**,
> article 42 excludes the opening day from the count and rolls the deadline forward off a holiday, and
> article 17 starts the complaint clock from the **expiry of the reply period** rather than the reply date —
> while a register usually records calendar dates only. So `PD-003` compares the actual reply date against the
> deadline **written in the register's own `答复期限` column**, and with that column empty it reports itself in
> `skipped`. Its finding says "this disagrees with the deadline you recorded", **not** "the reply is late".

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for a year's register use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `protest_deadline` tool. It reads one query-and-complaint register — the project header plus one
row per query — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PD-001` | a raise date or a reply date is recorded | warn | direct |
| `PD-002` | the reply date is not earlier than the raise date | warn | direct |
| `PD-003` | the reply falls inside the recorded deadline | info | local |
| `PD-004` | the complaint date is not earlier than the reply date | warn | direct |
| `PD-005` | the status comes from your vocabulary (off by default) | info | local |
| `PD-006` | the register names its procurement project | warn | principle |
| `PD-007` | query numbers are unique in the register | warn | principle |
## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-protest-deadline
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-protest-deadline'
```

## Configuration

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rulesFile` | string | `rules/protest-deadline.yaml` | Rule-pack path, relative to the package root |
| `disabledRules` | string[] | `[]` | Rule ids to stop running; each appears in `skipped` |
| `onlyRules` | string[] | `[]` | Run only

# dsh-soilwater-check — Soil and groundwater monitoring register completeness and arithmetic consistency check

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-soilwater-check` reads one soil and groundwater monitoring register — the project header plus one row per point and parameter — and checks that register's own completeness and arithmetic: that each row names its point and its parameter, that the recorded result parses as a number, that the sampling date parses and is not later than the check date, that an applicable standard is recorded, that the exceedance verdict agrees with how the result compares to the limit the register itself states, that no sample number is repeated, that the header declares the project and the survey phase, and that no template placeholder survives in the parameter column.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-soilwater-check: real output over its SW-002 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-soilwater-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-soilwater-check-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `SW-002` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| The register's verdict says 达标, but the result is higher than the limit written beside it. Is that caught? | Yes. `SW-005` compares the result with the limit the register itself records and reports the row when the verdict disagrees with that comparison. It ships no limits of its own, so it cannot find a limit taken from the wrong standard or the wrong land-use category, and a verdict outside its configured over/at-most lists is reported separately. |
| The `result` cell reads `未检出` or `<0.01`, because the value is below the detection limit. What does the check do? | `SW-002` reports it. The rule reads only the numeric part of a cell (`0.85` and `1.2×10-3` are accepted), so detection-limit notation is reported as unparseable on purpose — record the value and put the remark in another column, or disable the rule. It checks parseability, not whether the figure is true or the method correct. |
| One row leaves the `standard` column empty. | `SW-004` requires the standard to be filled on every row that carries that column. It checks that a standard is written, not that it is the one that applies: whether the recorded standard matches the land use and the medium is a substantive question the plugin leaves to the reader. |
| A row records a sampling date later than the check date, and another row writes the date as `2026/3/15`. | `SW-003` reports a `sampledAt` later than the check date. It reads `2026-03-15` and `2026-03-15 09:30`; any other form is reported as unparseable rather than silently skipped. The rule only compares the date — it does not judge whether the data is reliable. |
| The same `labNo` appears on two rows, because one sample was analysed for several parameters. | `SW-006` reports a repeated sample number, because a repeat breaks the link between the laboratory report and the register; comparison ignores whitespace. Several parameters of one sample sharing one sample number is the intended shape — keep them on separate rows, but do not reuse the row-number column. With no sample-number column at all, the rule reports itself in `skipped` instead of passing silently. |
| The `parameter` cell still reads `待填` or `【】`, because the register was copied from the template. | `SW-008` reports the leftover placeholder in the parameter column (`【`, `】`, `{{`, `XXX`, `待填`, `TBD`, `示例` and similar terms, editable in the pack). Note that `SW-001` asks only that the point name or the parameter be filled, so a placeholder counts as filled there; the placeholder rule is what catches it. Neither rule judges whether the factor is the right one to monitor. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《建设用地土壤污染状况调查技术导则》 | HJ 25.1—2019（代替 HJ 25.1-2014；条号本次未取得） | SW-001, SW-003, SW-007, SW-008 |
| 《地下水环境监测技术规范》 | HJ 164—2020（代替 HJ/T 164—2004；2020-12-01 发布、2021-03-01 实施；条号本次未取得） | SW-002, SW-006 |
| 《土壤环境质量 建设用地土壤污染风险管控标准（试行）》 | GB 36600—2018（本次未取得条文） | SW-004, SW-005 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **土壤与地下水监测台账** for completeness and arithmetic — that each record
names its point and parameter, that the result parses as a number, that the sampling date is not in the future,
that an applicable standard is recorded, that the exceedance verdict agrees with how the result compares to the
limit the register states, that sample numbers are unique, that the register names its project and survey phase,
and that no placeholder survives. It does **not** decide whether a site is contaminated, whether remediation is
needed, whether remediation targets were met, or whether a survey's conclusions hold.

> ### ⚠️ What this plugin deliberately cannot do
>
> **It ships no limits, and it does not check that the limit was taken from the right standard.** `SW-005`
> compares the measured result against the limit **the register itself records** and checks that the verdict
> agrees. So it **cannot find the consequential error: a screening value taken from the wrong standard or the
> wrong land-use category.** Deciding between GB 36600's first and second category screening values, or between
> GB 36600 and GB/T 14848, turns on the land use and the medium — this plugin reads neither. That limit is
> stated in the pack's header, in `SW-004`'s and `SW-005`'s notes, and in the troubleshooting section.
>
> `SW-002` requires a parseable number, so a register that writes detection-limit notation
> (`未检出`, `<0.01`) is **reported as unparseable on purpose** — record the value with a remark, or disable the
> rule.
>
> **Every `excerpt` in the rule pack says, in so many words, that the clause text was not obtained.** The regime
> lives in GB 36600—2018, GB/T 14848—2017, HJ 25.1 and HJ 164. The verification pass could not retrieve verbatim
> clause text, so the pack states the gap in the `excerpt` field itself and keeps every rule at `warn` or
> `info`. **When the texts are in hand, replace each `excerpt` with the real clause and raise `kind` to
> `direct`.**

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for a full sampling round use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `soilwater_check` tool. It reads one monitoring register — the project header plus one row per
point-and-parameter — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SW-001` | the point and the parameter are recorded | warn | principle |
| `SW-002` | the result parses as a number | warn | principle |
| `SW-003` | the sampling date is not in the future | warn | principle |
| `SW-004` | an applicable standard is recorded | warn | principle |
| `SW-005` | the verdict agrees with the result and the limit | warn | principle |
| `SW-006` | sample numbers are unique | warn | principle |
| `SW-007` | the register names its project and survey phase | warn | principle |
| `SW-008` | the parameter column holds no unreplaced placeholder | warn | principle |

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-soilwater-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-soilwater-check'
```

## Configuration

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rulesFile` | string | `rules/soilwater-check.yaml` | Rule-pack path, relative to the package root |
| `disabledRules` | string[] | `[]` | Rule ids to stop running; each appears in `skipped` |
| `onlyRules` | string[] | `[]` | Run only these rule ids; empty runs every rule |
| `skipNotes` | string |

# dsh-file-dedupe

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）文件查重插件：扫描任意本地目录，按 **SHA-256 内容哈希**找出**内容完全相同**的重复文件，并安全地清理。

一句话价值：**装完就能在界面左下角点「🔍 文件查重」，几十秒内知道哪些文件是重复的、能腾出多少空间。**

- **可视化面板**：应用左下角常驻的「🔍 文件查重」浮动按钮（点开即面板），以及 **设置 → 文件查重** 区块。
- **对话工具**：`file_dedupe_scan` / `file_dedupe_cleanup` / `file_dedupe_restore`，直接让 Agent 帮你查。
- **安全设计**：只处理确实属于某个重复组的路径；每个重复组永远至少保留一个文件；Agent 工具只能把冗余副本移入**可恢复的隔离区**，永久删除必须由你在面板里二次确认。

## 安装

从 GitHub 直接安装（推荐）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zizhuang/dsh-file-dedupe
```

把 `web` 换成你的 profile 名（`desktop`、`headless`、`tui` 等）。安装后重启/刷新即可看到浮动按钮。

> 尚未发布到 npm（因此 `add dsh-file-dedupe` 暂时不可用）；被社区插件市场收录后，也可以在应用内「设置 → 插件市场」一键安装。

## 工作原理

1. 遍历目标目录，先按**文件大小**分组；
2. 只对「同大小且存在多个成员」的候选文件做 **SHA-256** 哈希（1 MiB 流式分块，大文件不占内存）；
3. 内容哈希相同的文件即为真重复——与文件名无关。

结果包含：重复组数、冗余文件数、可释放空间、每组文件清单。

## 清理方式

| 操作 | 入口 | 可恢复 |
|---|---|---|
| 移入隔离区 | 面板 + `file_dedupe_cleanup` | ✅ 用 `file_dedupe_restore` 恢复 |
| 永久删除 | 仅面板，需二次确认 | ❌ |

隔离文件存放于 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-file-dedupe/quarantine/`，并记录清单；恢复时精确回到原路径（目标位置已被占用则拒绝覆盖）。

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中覆盖：

| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `minFileSize` | `1` | 忽略小于该字节数的文件 |
| `maxFiles` | `100000` | 单次扫描最多收录的文件数 |
| `maxGroups` | `500` | 展示的重复组上限（按可释放空间排序） |

## 对话工具示例

```
file_dedupe_scan(root="D:\\file store")            → 重复组清单 + 可释放空间
file_dedupe_cleanup(scanId="scan-…", paths=[…])    → 把冗余副本移入隔离区
file_dedupe_restore(paths=[…])                     → 从隔离区恢复
```

## 注意事项

- 查重是**字节级内容相同**判定：同名不同内容不算重复，不同名同内容算重复。
- 超大目录扫描需要时间，可用 `minFileSize` / `maxFiles` 缩小范围。
- 清理只影响你勾选的冗余副本，每组永远至少保留一个文件。

## 兼容性

在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`（Windows 桌面版）上实测通过：安装、宿主路由、浮动按钮/设置面板、扫描 → 隔离 → 恢复全流程。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-restart

给 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）**加一个**重启按钮**：点一下就把整个应用重启，回到原来的工作区。

## 简介

DSH 桌面版（Electron 外壳 + 它管理的服务端进程）没有提供任何界面内的重启入口：改完插件的服务端代码后，只能退出托盘再从快捷方式重新打开。本插件补上这个入口——一个直接落在窗口标题栏的重启按钮。

插件是普通 DSH 插件包，安装在你的 DSH profile 里（`desktop` 或 `web`），不修改 DSH 自身文件。按钮只有一个，**没有「关闭」**。

```
        ┌─────────────────────────────── 标题栏 ───────────────────────────────┐
        │  应用  编辑                                   [ ↻ ]   —    ❐    ✕     │
        └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                                    ↑ 本插件        ↑ 系统原生按钮
```

## 功能特性

* **标题栏重启按钮**：位于标题栏最右侧、系统窗口控制按钮（— ❐ ✕）的左边，点击即重启整个应用。
* **只有重启，没有关闭**：不会误触退出，也不会触发外壳的崩溃恢复对话框。
* **按钮总在**：没有桌面标题栏的环境（例如浏览器里的 `dsh web`、macOS 桌面）自动回退到会话头部工具区，渲染同一个按钮，两种位置互斥。
* **重启期间有反馈**：先出现整屏「DSH 正在重启…」提示，再整体退出并自动重新打开；失败时弹出错误气泡并给出日志位置。
* **零第三方依赖**：不使用运行时依赖，不联网下载任何东西。

## 安装

插件托管在 GitHub（`kee0012/dsh-restart`，未发布到 npm），DSH 支持以 git 依赖方式直接安装：

```sh
# 从 GitHub 安装（推荐，日常使用；拉取默认分支最新提交）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:kee0012/dsh-restart
```

> 安装后需要**重启 DSH**，新的服务端代码与 client bundle 才会生效。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-restart`，然后重启 DSH。

## 使用

1. 安装并重启 DSH 后，标题栏右侧会出现一个环形箭头按钮（标题栏不可用时则在会话头部）。
2. 悬停可见提示「立即重启 DeepSeek Harness（当前运行中的任务会中断）」。
3. 点击 → 出现「DSH 正在重启…」整屏提示 → 应用整体退出并自动重新打开 → 回到原来的工作区。
4. 若应用没有自动回来，按提示手动启动 DSH 即可；具体原因记录在日志里（见下一节）。

## 配置

无需配置，安装后即可使用。按钮位置按系统原生窗口按钮的宽度自动计算（见「已知限制」）。

## 兼容性

* **Profile**：`desktop`（桌面版，按钮落在窗口标题栏）与 `web`（`dsh web`，按钮落在会话头部工具区）。
* **操作系统**：Windows 桌面版为主要目标；macOS 桌面与 `dsh web` 走同构的 POSIX 路径。
* **运行环境**：Windows 需要 PowerShell 5.1+（系统自带）。不依赖 Node 之外的任何运行时。

## 实现方式

插件注册一个同源 HTTP 路由，由一段临时脚本在应用外部重启整个应用；脚本经 .NET 进程接口创建并 `detached` 脱离 DSH 的进程树（否则它会随被关闭的进程一起消失），关闭旧实例、等端口释放后重新拉起应用，并在任务结束时删除自己。脚本内含宿主的环境变量快照，因此只写在当前用户的临时目录、任务结束即自删；同目录还有一份诊断日志，仅在排查「点了没反应」时才有用。

「应用是否已经在运行」不靠进程名或父子关系判断，而是**认它的窗口**：枚举顶层窗口，只有属于本应用、可见、没有 owner、且窗口类名恰为 `Chrome_WidgetWin_1` 的才算一个实例。原因是打包后的 CLI 会在应用退出后留下一个没有窗口的 `dsh-desktop-host` 孤儿进程（父进程已死，于是它看起来也像「树根」），按进程关系判断会把它当成正在运行的应用，于是旧实例被关掉后再也不会有新的被拉起来。窗口探测失败时只记日志并照常拉起，绝不把「探测不出来」当成「已经在运行」。

## 已知限制

* 重启是**整应用级**的：所有窗口与未保存的输入都会一起消失（这是桌面版外壳的设计使然——只重启服务端会被判成崩溃）。
* **服务端代码不热重载**：修改插件 `src/` 后需要重新构建并**重启 DSH**，改动才生效。
* 标题栏按钮的位置按原生窗口按钮的宽度估算；若系统使用超大字号或非默认 DPI 缩放导致原生按钮变宽，按钮可能与其重叠或留缝。
* macOS 桌面的按钮落位与 Windows 相同，但重启路径（终止进程后重新打开应用）**尚未在真机验证**。
* Windows 依赖 PowerShell；它不可用时插件会退回到较弱的启动方式，重启可能失败（日志里有记录）。
* 助手脚本先用进程外的 .NET 进程接口拉起，且**必须回报一次「我已就位」宿主才继续**：脚本第一句会写一个就绪标记，宿主等到标记才去关闭应用。若助手没能起来，宿主会直接放弃这次重启并留下日志，而**不会**先把应用关掉——「关了却回不来」正是这条就绪握手机制要防的事。
* 与社区插件 `PangXitong/dsh-restart-button` 同时安装会出现两个重启入口，建议只保留一个。

## 反馈与贡献

发现了 bug 或有功能建议，欢迎在 [Issues](https://github.com/kee0012/dsh-restart/issues) 中反馈。提 PR 前请先跑通通用的构建与检查命令。

### 从源码构建

```sh
npm run bundle   # src/ → lib/（零依赖，仅用 Node 内置模块）
npm run gates    # 产物一致性门禁
npm test         # 单元与集成测试
npm run test:e2e # 助手脚本自删与重拉（会真的起进程，但不动正在运行的应用）
npm run test:sim # 启动握手离线取证：只报 pid 而不真启动的 launcher 必须被判失败
```

`src/` 是唯一的手写来源，`lib/` 由构建脚本生成，请不要手改 `lib/`。

## 许可证

MIT。重启按钮的落位思路参考了社区插件 `PangXitong/dsh-restart-button` 的公开实现（Apache-2.0）；本仓库为独立重写，只保留重启功能。

plugins.description: DSH Web UI plugin: a local server management console — resource overview, systemd services with live logs, file manager with on-demand sudo/root, apt updates, network, and a real PTY terminal.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-server-panel

把 DSH WebUI 变成**本机服务器运维控制台**：侧栏一枚"服务器"图标，点开是整页面板。
不新开端口、不引 nginx、不需要图形界面——插件挂在 dsh 自己的 Web 服务与 UI 上，
自动继承它的认证、主题、暗色模式与语言。

```
浏览器（经你的 SSH 隧道）
   └── 127.0.0.1:3080  dsh web
         ├── DSH 原有 UI
         └── dsh-server-panel
               ├── Client 半：左导航面板（总览/服务/文件/日志/软件包/网络）+ 命令面板
               └── Host 半：26 条 /dsh-server-panel/* 路由 + 采样器 + root 通道
```

## 界面（v2）

**顶栏**：主机名 · 发行版/负载/内存摘要 · 命令面板（⌘K / Ctrl+K）· 自动刷新开关 · root 身份胶囊。
**左导航**：总览 / 服务 / 文件 / 日志 / 软件包 / 网络。

| 页面 | 能力 |
|---|---|
| **总览** | 异常横幅（failed 单元、磁盘 ≥85%、内存 ≥90%、负载超核数、可升级包）→ CPU/内存/磁盘/系统四张 KPI 卡 → 常用服务快启（可收藏）→ 本次会话操作事件流 |
| **服务** | 分组（失败/运行中/开机自启/全部）+ 搜索；行内启停重启；**右侧抽屉**看状态与实时跟随的 journalctl 日志 |
| **文件** | 面包屑 + 常用位置书签；列表（名称/大小/时间/权限/属主）；覆盖层大编辑器（mtime 冲突检测）；上传/下载/新建/重命名/删除/chmod/chown |
| **日志** | 按单元 + 关键字过滤，**实时跟随**，行数可选（100–1000） |
| **软件包** | apt 模拟升级得出的可升级列表（当前 → 候选）、单包/全部升级、刷新索引、已安装查询 |
| **网络** | 网卡卡片（IP + 实时速率）、监听端口（root 时含全部进程名）、已建立连接 Top、防火墙现状 |

命令面板覆盖：跳页、解锁/锁定 root、刷新、暂停轮询、打开 `/etc`、打开 `/var/log`、刷新 apt 索引、升级全部。

## 权限模型

```
未解锁 ──[面板里输入 sudo 密码]──▶ 已解锁（root 身份，可一键锁定）
  ├ 文件：白名单（~、/etc、/var/log…）   ├ 文件：全盘可读可写
  ├ 日志：仅本用户可见                   ├ 日志：全量
  ├ 服务：只读                           ├ 服务：启停/重启/自启
  └ 软件包：只读                         └ 软件包：更新/升级
```

- 解锁后**所有模块**的请求自动带 `root=1`，不再逐模块判断；未解锁时点到需要权限的操作会直接弹解锁框，解锁后自动重试。
- 写**系统目录**（`/etc` `/boot` `/usr` `/lib*` `/bin` `/sbin` `/var/lib`）必须二次确认；关键目录（`/`、`/etc`、`/usr`、`/home` …）拒绝删除。
- 密码只写进 `sudo -S` 的 stdin，只存 dsh 进程内存；锁定、空闲 10 分钟、插件卸载即清除并 `sudo -k`。错误信息归一化，不回传 PAM 细节。
- 端口仍只监听 `127.0.0.1`，走你的隧道；**不要**把 3080 暴露到局域网。

## 路由

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/health` `/overview` | 插件自述 / 资源快照 |
| GET | `/services` `/services/logs` | 单元列表 / journalctl |
| POST | `/services/action` | start/stop/restart/reload/enable/disable（需 root） |
| GET/POST | `/sudo/state` `/sudo/unlock` `/sudo/lock` | 身份通道 |
| GET/PUT/POST | `/files/list` `/read` `/write` `/download` `/upload` `/mkdir` `/rename` `/delete` `/chmod` `/chown` `/roots` | 文件管理（`root=1` 走 root；`confirm=1` 过系统目录闸门） |
| GET | `/packages/upgradable` `/packages/installed` | apt 查询 |
| POST | `/packages/update-index` `/packages/upgrade` | 需 root |
| GET | `/network/overview` `/network/listeners` `/network/connections` | 网卡/端口/连接 |

## 目录

```
src/index.js      Host 入口：配置、采样器、sudo 会话、路由注册
src/routes.js     26 条路由：root 切换 + 系统目录闸门 + 错误码映射
src/fsroot.js     root 文件传输层（sudo -n find/cat/cp/mv/rm/chmod/chown）
src/files.js      普通身份文件服务（白名单 + realpath + mtime 乐观锁）
src/metrics.js    /proc 采样（CPU/内存/磁盘/网络/进程）
src/services.js   systemctl / journalctl 封装
src/packages.js   apt 模拟升级解析、索引刷新、升级
src/network.js    ip -j addr / ss 解析
src/sudo.js       内存态 sudo 会话（unlock/runRoot/spawnRoot/lock/dispose）
build.mjs         零依赖构建：src/*.js → lib/*.js，客户端包进模块加载器工厂
```

## 安装与迭代

```bash
node build.mjs          # 构建
node test/run.mjs       # 10 个测试文件、90+ 断言
# 安装：plugin_manager → install_bundle，target = 本目录绝对路径
```

**重要**：Host 半是 Node 模块，同一路径的模块在同一进程里只会求值一次——
改了 `src/*.js` 之后必须**重启 dsh**（电源按钮）才会加载新世代；只改
`cordis.patch.yml` 的 config 会即时生效。客户端半由页面加载，重启后一并刷新。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 lsl1931 — 仓库：<https://github.com/lsl1931/dsh-server-panel>

> 这个插件能在解锁后以 root 操作本机（改系统配置、启停服务、开 root 终端）。
> 请只在本机或可信隧道后面运行它，不要把端口直接暴露到公网。

# dsh-ohos-shell

本文件为双语对照，每节先中文，后英文。以下内容由两语共用，只出现一次：代码块、路径、命令、字段名、环境变量名、URL 与版本号。

This document is bilingual. Each section gives Chinese first, then English. These items are shared and appear once: code blocks, paths, commands, field names, environment variable names, URLs, and version numbers.

## 1 概述 / Overview

`dsh-ohos-shell` 是 deepseek-harness 的捆绑包（bundle）。它面向 HarmonyOS 与 OpenHarmony 设备，用于补齐子进程的运行环境。

`dsh-ohos-shell` is a bundle for deepseek-harness. It targets HarmonyOS and OpenHarmony devices. It completes the runtime environment of child processes.

本包只在 HarmonyOS 与 OpenHarmony 上生效。其它平台上两行 Host 插件拒绝运行，环境保持不变。

This package acts on HarmonyOS and OpenHarmony only. On every other platform both Host plugin rows refuse to run and the environment stays unchanged.

捆绑包向 profile 插入两行 Host 插件。

The bundle inserts two Host plugin rows into the profile.

| 行 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `ohos-shell-env` | 把运行环境写入主进程的 `process.env`，卸载时还原。 |
| `ohos-shell-facts` | 通过 `ctx.shellEnv` 发布同样的信息（`DSH_OHOS*`），供模型 shell 读取。 |

| Row | Function |
|---|---|
| `ohos-shell-env` | Writes the environment into the host process `process.env`. It restores the value at unload. |
| `ohos-shell-facts` | Publishes the same facts through `ctx.shellEnv` (`DSH_OHOS*`) for model shell calls. |

## 2 适用背景 / Background

鸿蒙不是普通的 Linux 主机。下面五项差异会影响 Harness 的子进程。

HarmonyOS is not a standard Linux host. Five differences below affect Harness child processes.

| 事实 | 后果 |
|---|---|
| `SHELL=/bin/sh`，而 `/bin/sh` 是 mksh（MirBSD Korn Shell） | mksh 读取 `${ENV:-~/.mkshrc}`。该文件不存在，因此它不读任何配置：没有别名、函数、补全与提示符。它既不是 bash，也不是 zsh。 |
| `/etc/shells` 不存在 | Harness 的 shell 发现没有注册表可查。 |
| `/tmp` 只读 | 必须有可写的 `TMPDIR`，否则 `os.tmpdir()` 返回 `/tmp`。 |
| 应用沙箱 uid（2000xxxx）不在 `/etc/passwd` 中 | Node 的 `os.userInfo()` 抛出 `uv_os_get_passwd ENOENT`。Node 命令行工具调用它时不加 `try`/`catch`。 |
| zsh 未随包发行函数库 | `fpath` 指向构建机，上游 281 个函数中只有 3 个存在，Harness 的 zsh 集成因此无法 autoload 所需函数。见 5.3 节。 |

| Fact | Consequence |
|---|---|
| `SHELL=/bin/sh`, and `/bin/sh` is mksh (MirBSD Korn Shell) | mksh reads `${ENV:-~/.mkshrc}`. That file does not exist, so mksh reads no configuration. It has no aliases, functions, completions, or prompt. It is not bash and not zsh. |
| `/etc/shells` does not exist | The Harness shell discovery has no registry to read. |
| `/tmp` is read-only | A writable `TMPDIR` is necessary. Without it, `os.tmpdir()` returns `/tmp`. |
| The app sandbox uid (2000xxxx) has no `/etc/passwd` entry | Node `os.userInfo()` throws `uv_os_get_passwd ENOENT`. Node command-line tools call it without a `try`/`catch`. |
| zsh ships without its function library | `fpath` points at the build machine. Only 3 of the 281 upstream functions exist, so the Harness zsh integration cannot autoload the functions it needs. See section 5.3. |

侧栏终端按下面的表达式解析 shell。`dsh-subprocess-local` 从 `process.env.SHELL` 取默认值。

The sidebar terminal resolves its shell with the expression below. `dsh-subprocess-local` reads the default value from `process.env.SHELL`.

```
subprocess.terminalEnvironment().defaultShell ?? '/bin/sh'
```

`terminal-controller` 行没有 `shell` 配置。侧栏打开的是 `/bin/sh -i`，也就是 mksh，它不读 rc。内置的 Settings → Shell 页面只改命令超时与输出上限，改不了这一项。

The `terminal-controller` row has no `shell` configuration. The sidebar opens `/bin/sh -i`, which is mksh, and mksh reads no rc file. The built-in Settings → Shell page changes only the command timeout and the output cap. It cannot change this value.

## 3 环境要求 / Requirements

运行前请确认以下条件：

Make sure that these conditions are true:

- 设备运行 HarmonyOS 或 OpenHarmony。这是硬条件：插件在激活时自行判定平台，其它平台上两行插件拒绝运行，各记录一条 `error`，环境保持不变。
- 已安装 harmonybrew，前缀默认为 `~/.harmonybrew`。
- 已通过 harmonybrew 安装 deepseek-harness。
- 系统提供 `/usr/bin/zsh`。

- The device runs HarmonyOS or OpenHarmony. This is a hard condition. Each plugin row decides the platform at activation. On every other platform both rows refuse to run, each one logs an `error`, and the environment stays unchanged.
- harmonybrew is installed. The default prefix is `~/.harmonybrew`.
- deepseek-harness is installed through harmonybrew.
- The system provides `/usr/bin/zsh`.

## 4 安装 / Installation

本包发布在 npm 上。请通过 Harness 的插件管理器安装，或在插件市场里搜索本包。

The package is published on npm. Install it through the Harness plugin manager, or search for it in the plugin market.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ohos-shell
```

插件管理器会完成两步：把包装入 profile，并把包名写入 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

The plugin manager completes two steps. It installs the package into the profile, and it writes the package name into `dsh.profile.bundles`.

安装后，profile 的 `package.json` 应包含下面的条目。

After the installation, the profile `package.json` contains the entries below.

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-ohos-shell": "^1.1.0"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["...", "dsh-ohos-shell"]
    }
  }
}
```

在设备上开发本包时，也可以把本包的绝对路径交给插件管理器。它会把该路径记为 `link:` 依赖。

While you develop this package on the device, give the plugin manager the absolute path of this package. It records that path as a `link:` dependency.

请勿手工编辑 profile 的 `package.json` 或 `cordis.patch.yml`。插件管理器负责这两步。

Do not edit the profile `package.json` or `cordis.patch.yml` by hand. The plugin manager owns these two steps.

## 5 功能 / What it does

### 5.1 环境变量 / Environment variables

`scrubbedParentEnv()` 在每次 spawn 时读取 `process.env`。`PATH`、`HOME`、区域设置与代理变量能通过这层清洗，凭据类名称与 `DSH_*` 名称不能。

`scrubbedParentEnv()` reads `process.env` at every spawn. `PATH`, `HOME`, locale, and proxy variables survive that scrub. Credential-shaped names and `DSH_*` names do not survive.

主进程在激活时改一次环境，就能同时覆盖侧栏终端、模型 shell、子智能体与 MCP 服务。

One change at activation in the host process reaches the sidebar terminal, the model shell, subagents, and MCP servers.

下表列出它设置的键。

The table below lists the keys that it sets.

| 键 | 值 |
|---|---|
| `PATH` | 去重，并按 `~/.zshrc` 的顺序把 harmonybrew 放在最前：`opt/rustup/bin`、pnpm `bin`、`opt/portable-git/bin`、`bin`、`sbin`。其余继承目录保留。 |
| `SHELL` | `zsh` 与 `bash` 中第一个存在的。 |
| `TMPDIR` | 先取继承的 `TMPDIR`，再取 `$HOME/.tmp`（不存在则创建），取第一个**真正可写**的目录。可写性用一次真实写入探测，因为 `/tmp` 在只读挂载上仍带 `1777` 权限。 |
| `NODE_OPTIONS` | 当 `$HOME/.config/node-ohos/userinfo-shim.cjs` 存在且尚未写入时，前置 `--require`。 |
| `FPATH` | 依次为：本包的 `zsh-functions/`、平台函数目录、继承的 `FPATH`。`FPATH` 与 zsh 的 `fpath` 特殊参数绑定，见 5.3 节。 |
| `HOMEBREW_PREFIX`、`HOMEBREW_CELLAR`、`HOMEBREW_REPOSITORY` | 探测到的前缀与继承值不同时写入。 |
| `INFOPATH` | 缺少 `<prefix>/share/info` 时前置。 |

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| `PATH` | De-duplicated, with harmonybrew first in the order that `~/.zshrc` establishes: `opt/rustup/bin`, pnpm `bin`, `opt/portable-git/bin`, `bin`, `sbin`. Other inherited directories stay. |
| `SHELL` | The first of `zsh` and `bash` that exists. |
| `TMPDIR` | The inherited `TMPDIR`, then `$HOME/.tmp` (created if absent). The first **actually writable** directory wins. A real write tests writability, because `/tmp` carries mode `1777` on a read-only mount. |
| `NODE_OPTIONS` | Prepends `--require` when `$HOME/.config/node-ohos/userinfo-shim.cjs` exists and is not present yet. |
| `FPATH` | In order: the `zsh-functions/` directory of this package, the platform functions directory, the inherited `FPATH`. `FPATH` is tied to the zsh `fpath` special parameter. See section 5.3. |
| `HOMEBREW_PREFIX`, `HOMEBREW_CELLAR`, `HOMEBREW_REPOSITORY` | Written when the detected prefix differs from the inherited value. |
| `INFOPATH` | Prepends `<prefix>/share/info` when it is absent. |

本包不改动模型 shell 的 `bash` 工具。`dsh-bash-local` 固定执行 `bash -c`，把 `SHELL` 改成 zsh 不影响它。

This package does not change the model shell `bash` tool. `dsh-bash-local` always runs `bash -c`, so a change of `SHELL` to zsh does not touch it.

### 5.2 侧栏默认 shell / Sidebar default shell

侧栏原来打开 mksh，因为主进程的 `SHELL` 是 `/bin/sh`。本包把 `SHELL` 指向第一个可用的 zsh 或 bash，侧栏的默认值随之改变。

The sidebar opened mksh before, because the host process `SHELL` was `/bin/sh`. This package points `SHELL` at the first available zsh or bash. The sidebar default changes with it.

选单中的候选 shell 来自 `shellCandidates` 配置，默认值为 `zsh`、`bash`、`fish`、`pwsh`、`powershell`、`cmd`。它们按 `PATH` 解析。

The candidate shells in the menu come from the `shellCandidates` configuration. The default value is `zsh`, `bash`, `fish`, `pwsh`, `pow

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: fixes dsh-ui table cells painting text over the next column, and wraps long cells instead of forcing a horizontal scrollbar.
plugins.readme_text:
# @adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh) plugin that repairs `dsh-ui` table rendering:

- **cells no longer paint their text over the next column** — the bug where a long run of inline-code chips bleeds across the column boundary;
- **long cells wrap** instead of stretching the table until it needs a horizontal scrollbar.

It applies to the shipped `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui` **0.11.x** and does not wait for an upstream release. Once upstream ships its own fix, this plugin stays harmless and can simply be removed.

## What it fixes

`dsh-ui` table cells default to `white-space: nowrap` (the plugin's deliberate "data columns do not fold" voice). Meanwhile the host shell renders message bodies inside a `.markdown` subtree, and two rules from that sheet land on `dsh-ui` output because the components render in the same subtree:

```css
.markdown { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }                 /* inherited by every cell */
.markdown :not(pre) > code { display: inline-flex; }   /* every chip becomes an atomic inline box */
```

Add the plugin's own `.inlineCode { white-space: pre-wrap }` and the chip's **automatic minimum size collapses**: the column may be sized below its own content, while the cell's `nowrap` still paints the text unbroken — straight over the neighbouring column.

Only cells containing inline code are affected. A pure-text cell is `nowrap`, so its min-content already equals its content width and the column can never be sized below it.

Measured on a live DSH desktop page (7 tables): on 0.11.4, 4 tables and 12 cells overflowed, the worst single cell by **704px**.

## The two rules it injects

```css
/* 1) Table chips must not re-open line breaking — this is the root cause. */
[class*="tableWrap"] table [class*="inlineCode"] { white-space: pre !important; }

/* 2) Single-line data cells wrap — long content no longer stretches the table. */
[class*="tableWrap"] table td:not([class*="tdMultiline"]):not([class*="tdCode"]),
[class*="tableWrap"] table th:not([class*="tdMultiline"]):not([class*="tdCode"]) {
  white-space: normal !important;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
```

The selectors use only **CSS Modules class-name prefixes** (`tableWrap`, `inlineCode`, `tdMultiline`, `tdCode`), never the build-time hash, so they survive plugin upgrades.

Rule 2 is a **preference**. Remove that block from `lib/client.js` if you would rather keep the upstream behaviour of a wider table plus horizontal scrolling.

## Geometry verification

The same browser fixture, in an 801px container:

| Styles | Table width | Horizontal scroll | Cross-column bleed |
|---|---|---|---|
| upstream 0.11.4 (unfixed) | 1471px | yes | **4 cells, worst 306px** |
| upstream `main` (fix #282) | 1777px | yes | none |
| **this plugin** | **799px** | **no** | **none** |

In other words: the upstream repair makes the table wider and asks you to scroll; this plugin lets the long content wrap, so the table fits the conversation column.

## Install

The plugin is an ordinary DSH bundle: a dependency in a profile, plus one entry in that profile's bundle list.

### From npm

1. Add it to the profile you want it in — `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`:

   ```json
   {
     "dependencies": {
       "@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix": "^0.1.0"
     },
     "dsh": {
       "profile": {
         "bundles": ["…", "@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix"]
       }
     }
   }
   ```

2. Install it:

   ```
   cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile> && pnpm install
   ```

3. **Restart the DSH app.** The host-side plugin tree is assembled when the process starts, so a running instance will not pick up a new bundle.

If pnpm refuses the freshly published version because of a minimum-release-age policy, add the package name to `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` in that profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`.

### From a local checkout

Use a `link:` path instead of the version, for example `"@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix": "link:/path/to/dsh-genui-bugfix"`, then run the same two steps.

## Verify

After a restart the renderer carries one extra stylesheet:

```js
document.getElementById('dsh-genui-bugfix/table-overflow')   // non-null once loaded
```

Visually: tables with long inline-code runs no longer print text over the next column, and their width matches the conversation column instead of scrolling.

Without DSH running you can still check both halves against the loader contract:

```
cd <plugin> && npm test
```

## Uninstall

1. Remove `@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix` from the profile's `dependencies` and `bundles`;
2. `pnpm install`;
3. restart DSH.

## Relation to the upstream fix

- Upstream `main` already fixes the overlap itself (PR [#282](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui/pull/282), not yet released). Rule 1 here has the same effect and coexists with it — both keep the chip at `white-space: pre`.
- The upstream browser fixture cannot catch that regression: its cross-column assertion is vacuously true because the fixture renders tables outside the host `.markdown` cascade. See issue [#285](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui/issues/285) and PR [#286](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui/pull/286).

## Layout

```
@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix/
├── package.json        # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client declarations
├── cordis.patch.yml    # inserts one plugin row into the profile
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js        # host half: node ESM, exports name/apply/inject, no behaviour
│   └── client.js       # browser half: window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })
├── test/verify.mjs     # zero-dependency self-check of the loader contract
└── README.md
```

Both halves follow the shapes already used by shipped plugins:

- the **host** half is plain node ESM exporting `name` / `apply` / `inject` — the same shape as the host half of `dsh-window-drag-probe`, which also has no host-side behaviour;
- the **client** half must be the pre-bundled form DSH serves to the renderer, `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`, where `factory` returns the exports carrying `apply` — the same shape as the client artifacts of `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui` and `dsh-boot-animation`. A plain ESM `export function apply` is **not** loaded, and it fails silently rather than reporting an error. This plugin has no runtime dependencies, so its factory never needs `require`.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Machine directory, SSH health checks, and model-authored application UI cards for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Machine & Apps

DeepSeek Harness 的统一机器与应用管理插件。一个安装包提供机器目录、SSH 连接探测、机器引用，以及模型编写的应用监控/控制卡片；附带三套使用与扩展 skills。非 DeepSeek 官方插件。

## 支持范围

已验证 Linux、DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-alpha.1`、Node `24.19`。Node `22.13` 是 API 最低要求，尚未实测；建议使用已验证版本。DSH 仍在快速迭代，不承诺跨版本兼容。

SSH 探测需要 `ssh`、`ssh-keyscan`、`ssh-keygen`。可选 libvirt 观察需要 `virsh`。插件不会修改局域网开放、代理、认证或 GPU 服务。

## 安装

下载预构建安装包，在运行 DSH 的用户下安装到现有 Web profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-machine-apps-0.3.0.tgz --allow-build=esbuild
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

重启 DSH 并刷新浏览器。无需安装其他机器管理或应用卡片插件。`--allow-build=esbuild` 仅允许扩展构建器所需的 esbuild 安装脚本，不是允许所有依赖执行脚本；安装前应确认包的来源可信。此参数已在 pnpm 11 验证。旧版 pnpm 若不支持该参数，请按其提示在 profile 内批准 esbuild 后重试。

本地命令执行默认未授权。需要时在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中添加自己的目录白名单（替换示例路径）：

```yaml
- id: machine-apps
  name: dsh-machine-apps
  config:
    appCards:
      hostRoots:
        - /srv/workspace
```

DSH 对同一行的 config 使用替换语义；已有配置时请保留其他必要字段。远程操作使用登记的 SSH 身份，卡片的执行授权仍需人工确认。

## 使用

在机器面板登记机器与连接，查看连接状态，通过 @ 气泡将机器附加到对话。应用卡片在机器详情中展示；模型通过配套 `machine-management`、`app-cards-authoring` 和 `app-cards-extensions` skills 了解工具、声明格式、真实预览与扩展流程。

卡片发布、执行审批和回执独立于外观声明。修改功耗等操作不会因为打开页面或安装插件自动执行。

## 数据与升级

默认数据根目录为 `DSH_HOME`，未设置时为 `~/.dsh`：

- `machines/`：机器 JSON、说明和历史。
- `machine-mgmt/ssh/`：SSH config 与 known_hosts；这是稳定数据路径，不是旧插件依赖。
- `app-cards/`：声明、修订、SQLite 索引、回执和动态扩展。

支持 `dataRoot`、`machineRoot`、`sshDir`、`appCards.dataPath` 覆盖路径。升级前停止 DSH 并备份数据，在同一 profile 中安装新版本，重启并刷新页面。卸载只移除插件，不删除数据：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-machine-apps
```

## 开发与打包

```sh
npm ci
npm run build
npm test
npm run test:apps
npm pack
```

`machines/` 和 `apps/` 是同一插件的内部模块，没有独立插件安装入口；`shared/` 提供共用 UI。数据格式与工具名称保持稳定。

预构建包包含运行产物与 skills。自定义卡片扩展控制器位于安装包内 `apps/lib/extensionctl.js`，示例位于 `apps/examples/extensions/range/`。构建扩展不需要修改或重启宿主插件。

目前分发方式为预构建 tgz；不要把源码仓库当作可直接 git 安装的包。官方安装机制见 [DSH 插件打包文档](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md)。

plugins.description: DSH skill: inline version stamps for text artifacts, plus a drift check that works as a CI gate
plugins.readme_text:
> 🕒 v2 · 2026-10-10 08:52 · dsh-agent ｜ 变更：加实测演示图（docs/demo.png） ｜ 上一版：v1 · 2026-10-10 08:50

# dsh-artifact-stamp

给**文本产物**盖「时间戳 + 版本号」的**行内版本戳**，并提供一个可当 CI 关卡用的体检命令。

一句话：**给文档做一版手工简化的 git** —— 但戳写在文件**自己身上**，人眼一眼可见，机器也能解析。

## 为什么会有这个

当 agent 频繁改写 `.md`（笔记、技能、README、实验记录）时，会遇到一个问题：

- **git 不适合**：文档是持续追加的，每次改动都 commit 太重；而且看历史要跳出文件本身
- **不管也不行**：你打开一个文档，**不知道它什么时候写的、这一版改了什么、上一版长什么样**

所以约定一条：**每个文本产物的正文最前面，有一行可读、可解析的戳**。

```
> 🕒 v2 · 2026-10-10 08:50 · dsh-agent ｜ 变更：补实验结论 ｜ 上一版：v1 · 2026-10-10 08:48
```

> 🔴 **没有脚本守的约定一定会漂移。** 所以这条约定配了工具 + 体检命令：
> `check` 会比对「戳里的时间」与「文件 mtime」，**改过却没盖戳 → 退出码 1**。

## 装

本仓库根目录就是一个 **DSH 技能**，clone 后放进用户级技能根即可：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yanggaihao5-sys/dsh-artifact-stamp.git
cp -r dsh-artifact-stamp ~/.dsh/skills/artifact-stamp
```

Windows（PowerShell）：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/yanggaihao5-sys/dsh-artifact-stamp.git
Copy-Item -Recurse dsh-artifact-stamp "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\artifact-stamp"
```

只用命令行也行（**纯标准库、无网络、可离线跑**）：

```bash
python scripts/artifact_stamp.py new  <file> --note "初稿"
python scripts/artifact_stamp.py bump <file> --note "补数据"
python scripts/artifact_stamp.py show <file>
python scripts/artifact_stamp.py check <路径...> [--days 30] [--include-code]
python scripts/artifact_stamp.py strip <路径...> --dry-run
```

| 子命令 | 干什么 |
|---|---|
| `new` | 新建时盖 v1（已有戳则不覆盖） |
| `bump` | 改完后升版 v1→v2；**note 没变就不升版**（除非 `--force`） |
| `show` | 看当前戳 |
| `check` | 体检：缺戳 / **改过没盖戳** / 戳过期；**退出码 1 = 有违规** |
| `strip` | 回滚：一键删掉所有戳行（`--dry-run` 先预览） |

## 实测演示

![实测输出](docs/demo.png)

> 上图是 `demo/` 里**真实跑出来的输出**的排版图（不是终端截屏；emoji 以文字替代）。

```
$ python scripts/artifact_stamp.py new demo/design.md --note "初稿：设计笔记"
stamped v1: demo/design.md

# 过了 95 秒后改了内容，但忘了盖戳：
$ python scripts/artifact_stamp.py check demo
  ✗ 改过没盖戳：文件 mtime=2026-10-10 08:50，戳=2026-10-10 08:48（v1）
      demo/design.md

统计：文本文件 1 · 有戳 1 · 缺戳 0 · 改过没盖戳 1 · 戳超过 30 天 0 · 非UTF8跳过 0 · PS无BOM 0
判定：有违规（退出码 1）。修复：`artifact_stamp.py new <file>` 或 `bump <file> --note "..."`

$ python scripts/artifact_stamp.py bump demo/design.md --note "补实验结论"
bumped: demo/design.md -> v2 @ 2026-10-10 08:50

$ python scripts/artifact_stamp.py check demo
统计：文本文件 1 · 有戳 1 · 缺戳 0 · 改过没盖戳 0 · 戳超过 30 天 0 · 非UTF8跳过 0 · PS无BOM 0
判定：全部合规 ✅
```

盖完的正文长这样：

```
> 🕒 v2 · 2026-10-10 08:50 · dsh-agent ｜ 变更：补实验结论 ｜ 上一版：v1 · 2026-10-10 08:48

# 设计笔记

第一版。

补了一段实验结论。
```

## 支持哪些文件类型

戳必须写成该文件类型合法的注释，否则会把源码写坏。已内建映射：

| 扩展名 | 前缀 |
|---|---|
| `.md` `.markdown` `.txt` `.rst` `.org` | `> ` |
| `.py` `.ps1` `.sh` `.yaml` `.toml` `.ini` `.r` `.jl` `.m` … | `# ` |
| `.js` `.ts` `.c` `.cpp` `.java` `.go` `.rs` … | `// ` |
| `.tex` `.bib` `.sty` `.cls` | `% ` |
| `.vbs` `.vba` `.bas` | `' ` |

**不认识的类型直接拒绝盖戳并报错**（而不是硬插一行把文件弄坏）。

## 🔴 已知限制（先说清楚）

1. **90 秒分辨率**：戳只有**分钟精度**，而 mtime 是秒精度。所以**盖戳后 90 秒内的改动 `check` 检测不到**（默认 `--tolerance 90` 就是为了吸收这个偏差）。
   ⚠️ **`--tolerance 0` 不是可用设置**——它会对每个刚盖过戳的文件都报漂移。想要更灵敏只能把戳精度改成秒。
2. **不是 git 的替代品**：它只记「**什么时候、改了什么（一句话）**」，**不存差异、不能回滚内容**。真正的版本控制仍然用 git。
3. **不改文件编码**：原文件带 UTF-8 BOM 就保留，没有就不加。**唯一例外**是给 `.ps1` 写进非 ASCII 时会自动补 BOM（Windows PowerShell 5.1 会把无 BOM 的脚本按 GBK 读 → 中文乱码/语法错）。
4. **保护 YAML frontmatter**：`SKILL.md` 这类带 `---` 头的文件，戳插在 frontmatter **之后**。
5. **保护 shebang**：`.py` 的 `#!` 与 PEP-263 编码行永远留在最前（早期版本曾把戳插到第 1 行，导致 `./x.py` 直接执行失效）。
6. **体检默认跳过** `.git` / `node_modules` / `__pycache__` / `backups` / `_归档`；默认不检查 `.json`（数据文件不该盖戳）。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 对DeepSeek Harness的本地爆改合集：源码补丁、界面补丁包、皮肤、字体方案、启动器，以及把这些东西改出来时踩过的坑和判据。
plugins.readme_text:
# Nuestra Señora del Trono de Sabiduría, Espejo de Justicia, Salud de los Enfermos, Refugio de los Pecadores, Arca de la Alianza y Estrella de la Mañana

## `dsh-taller-y-relojeria-de-sandrone` —— 桑多涅的工坊与钟表铺

对 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)（DSH）的**本地爆改合集**：源码补丁、界面补丁包、皮肤、字体方案、启动器、**System Prompt 设计**，以及把这些东西改出来时踩过的坑和判据。


> 标题是Letanías lauretanas里六个真称号的串联，你去核对原剧情我反正觉得差不多对（草生）
>

---

## ⚠️ 三条前提（先读，能省你很多时间）

1. **本仓零位图**。没有任何 `png/jpg/webp/gif`（唯一例外是随包字体与 `bench/katex/` 里的 KaTeX 字体，都在 [`NOTICE.md`](NOTICE.md) 列明）。皮肤背景请**自备**，见 [`skins/navia/README.md`](skins/navia/README.md)。
2. **皮肤只包含作者自己做的那个**（`navia`）。著名全家桶插件`dsh-web-all`里的其它主题各有作者与各自的授权，不在这里。
3. **补丁是版本耦合的，而且会大声报错**。`patches/*/manifest.toml` 里带着对上游源码结构的断言：**版本对不上就拒绝打补丁并报出漂移点**，不会静默打歪。

---

## 目录

| 目录 / 文件 | 里面是什么 | 怎么用 |
|---|---|---|
| **`patches/`** | 源码补丁的版本无关存档：`manifest.toml` + 可 `git apply` 的 `.patch` + 为什么 | 用 [`tools/dsh-ui-patches.py`](tools/dsh-ui-patches.py) 核对/重放；也可手工 `git apply` |
| **`packages/dsh-sandrone-ui-patches/`** | UI 补丁包：以 **client 半区注入全局 CSS** 的方式改界面（字体方案 / 字号倍率 / 随包可变字体 / 皮肤压制 / 长会话渲染剪枝） | `pnpm add file:packages/dsh-sandrone-ui-patches`（见包内 README） |
| **`skins/navia/`** | 一个皮肤：浅底侧栏 + 深底主区 + 毛玻璃（**图自备**） | 放进 home 的 `skins/` 下，重启 |
| **`notes/`** | 脱敏后的实操笔记：排版、皮肤、升级、部署、issue、提示词、检索 | 读**为什么**；配方数值会随版本过期，判据不会 |
| **`tools/`** | 实用工具：补丁护栏、home 硬链接修复、补丁分层检查、H1 强制，以及**皮肤取色探测** [`skin-color-probe.py`](tools/skin-color-probe.py)（拿一张主题图直接出「该配浅底还是深底」的判决 + 白/黑字对比度） | 直接跑（多为 `--help` 自明） |
| **`start-web.py`** | DSH 启动器：起 / 停 / 查 / 试新版本 / 回收运行记录，实现全在这一个文件 | 先看 [`启动器配置和日志/README.md`](启动器配置和日志/README.md) |
| **`prompts/`** | 五个使用场景的 **System Prompt 设计**（从 DSH **活配置**提取，不是历史快照）+ 该目录的 CC BY-SA 许可全文 | 先读 [`prompts/README.md`](prompts/README.md)：架构、五条设计取向、对话索引机制 |
| **`docs/`** | [长会话渲染实测报告](docs/perf-long-session-rendering.md)（含一条方法学教训：`--headless` 不能用来测 layout）；[System Prompt 相关研究与实践](docs/RESEARCH.md)（110 条参考文献，含逐条证据分级与检索缺口声明） | 读结论；复现材料在 `bench/` |
| **`bench/`** | 渲染基准的复现材料（含 KaTeX 字体） | 见报告 |

---

## 三个源码补丁

| 补丁 | 一句话 | 文档 |
|---|---|---|
| **Markdown 渲染** | 让**用户消息**按 Markdown 渲染（这是上游的产品选择，本地选了另一条） | [`patches/Markdown渲染/`](patches/Markdown渲染/) |
| **空回复兜底** | 让「只吐思考链、`finish=stop`」的退化响应变成**可重试的 `EMPTY_RESPONSE`**，而不是一条静默落盘、界面上什么都不显示的空白回复 | [`patches/空回复兜底/dsh-empty-response-content.md`](patches/空回复兜底/dsh-empty-response-content.md) |
| **沙盒 scratch 落点** | 让 `workspace-write` 沙盒拥有一个**跨调用存活**的临时目录 —— bwrap 在 `--tmpfs /tmp` 之后把宿主的一个子目录 bind 回去（其余 `/tmp` 保持每次全新）；顺带解决「沙盒里 `mkdir /tmp/x` 下次调用就没了」 | [`patches/sandbox-scratch/`](patches/sandbox-scratch/) |

后者的排查过程值得单看：一场真实会话 153 轮里 **13 轮**收尾只产出 reasoning 块、正文一个 token 都没生成，而**两层空响应守卫都在问错的问题**（数的是「有没有开过块」而不是「有没有可交付内容」）——其中一处还有一条**把错误行为写成契约的测试**（`keeps a thinking-only stop successful`）。文档里有完整的取证链。

---

## 环境变量与可移植性

这些工具是从我们那台机器上搬出来的，所以**根目录不写死**：

| 变量 | 作用 | 缺省 |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_HARNESS_DIR` | harness 根目录（启动器给子进程注入的就是它） | 由脚本自身位置推导（`tools/` 的上一级） |
| `DSH_TRACE_LOG` | 取证日志落点（用来实现「每实例一份」） | 启动器按实例路径注入；没走启动器时落 `.dsh-scratch/fetch-trace.log` |
| `DSH_H1_MODE_FILE` | H1 实验的「臂」开关文件 | 随实例记录目录 |

⇒ **把它们放在 `<任意目录>/tools/` 下、旁边有 `start-web.py`，就能自动认祖归宗**；实在推不出来会**报错而不是猜**。

`.dsh-scratch/` 是「没走启动器」时的匿名取证落点（我们那边这个目录叫「草稿纸与垃圾桶」，发布件里换成了中性名）。写日志的 preload 有 `try/catch` 兜底，**目录不存在也不会拖垮宿主**。

⚠️ 仍要说清：`start-web.py` 与 `tools/` 里几个脚本**是按我们自己的工作区布局写的**（`原始代码研究/<版本>/` 检出、`dsh-domus-<版本>/` 实例 home、`启动器配置和日志/`），它们是**参考实现** —— 照这个结构摆能用，扔进别的布局会明确报错。

---

## 授权与素材

- 本仓代码：**MIT**（见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)）。
- 文本内容（`notes/`、`prompts/`、`docs/`）：[`CC BY-SA 4.0`](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/deed.zh-hans)（`prompts/` 的许可全文在 [`prompts/LICENSE`](prompts/LICENSE)）。两者是**聚集体**：CC BY-SA 不传染到代码，反亦然。
- 第三方素材（随包字体 SIL OFL 1.1、KaTeX MIT、上游 DSH MIT）：逐项见 [`NOTICE.md`](NOTICE.md)。
- **本仓不含任何插画／摄影素材**，也**不含任何凭据**。所有笔记在发布前经过确定性脱敏（机器路径与用户名已替换），并没有「顺手」保留原文。

> ⚠️ 这是**非官方**的本地改动合集，与 DSH 上游无隶属关系。补丁都是对特定版本的定点修改，升级后请先核对。

plugins.description: DSH File Converter: local file conversion across 20 tool chains and 1000+ format pairs — convert files, query the format matrix, and check converter availability via model tools.  DSH 文件格式转换插件：跨 20 个转换器、覆盖 1000+ 格式对，以模型工具提供本地文件转换、格式矩阵查询与转换器可用性检测
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-converter

[**English**](README.md) | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A **file conversion plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness)**. It provides a conversion engine
that covers **20 tool chains / 1000+ format pairs**
(images / audio-video / documents / e-books / 3D / spreadsheets ...) and runs entirely through
external CLIs (`ffmpeg`, `pandoc`, `libreoffice`, `imagemagick`, `vips`, `calibre`, ...) or pure JS (`vcf`),
exposed to the model as tools.

DSH framework docs: <https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/develop/basic/>

## 1. Tools

| Tool                | Purpose                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `convert_file`      | Convert a local file: `{ inputPath, to, from?, outputPath?, converter? }`. Output defaults to the input directory (same name, new extension). Unsupported pairs return the list of available targets; missing converter returns the install command |
| `list_conversions`  | Query the format matrix: pass `from` to get that format's convertible targets (grouped by converter); omit it for a full category overview             |
| `check_converters`  | Detect which converter CLIs are available on this machine (with version numbers)                                                                        |

## 2. Installation

### From npm / GitHub

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-converter                        # install from npm
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ai-tool-labs/dsh-converter    # or from GitHub
# Desktop: open the "Plugins" panel in the sidebar → click "Add Plugin" → type "dsh-converter" → Install
# Restart harness after installing to take effect (Desktop: restart the App; Web: restart dsh web)
```

### From source (developer)

```bash
# 1) Build
pnpm install && pnpm --filter dsh-converter build

# 2) Install into a profile (example: web profile)
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-plugins/packages/dsh-converter
```

### Enable in the profile

Append the following to `<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (the shipped `cordis.patch.yml` shows all
options, commented out):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: file-converter
      name: dsh-converter
      config:
        enableTools: true
        enableSkill: true
        maxFileSizeMb: 500      # per-file size limit (default 500MB, matches the Web version)
        timeoutMs: 300000       # external CLI timeout (default 5 minutes)
```

## 3. Converter dependencies

`check_converters` tells you which converters are missing; install commands per platform:

| Converter   | Purpose                 | macOS                             | Ubuntu                       | Windows                  |
| ----------- | ----------------------- | --------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| ffmpeg      | Audio / video / GIF     | `brew install ffmpeg`             | `apt install ffmpeg`         | `choco install ffmpeg`   |
| pandoc      | Universal doc conversion| `brew install pandoc`             | `apt install pandoc`         | `choco install pandoc`   |
| libreoffice | Office / PDF            | `brew install --cask libreoffice` | `apt install libreoffice`    | `choco install libreoffice` |
| imagemagick | Images                  | `brew install imagemagick`        | `apt install imagemagick`    | `choco install imagemagick` |
| vips        | Images (high-perf)      | `brew install vips`               | `apt install libvips-tools`  | `choco install vips`     |
| calibre     | E-books                 | `brew install --cask calibre`     | `apt install calibre`        | `choco install calibre`  |
| inkscape    | Vector graphics         | `brew install --cask inkscape`    | `apt install inkscape`       | `choco install inkscape` |
| xelatex     | LaTeX → PDF             | `brew install --cask mactex`      | `apt install texlive-xetex`  | install MiKTeX           |
| vcf         | Contacts vcf → csv      | ✅ pure JS, no install            | ✅                            | ✅                       |

See `src/engine/installCommands.ts` for the full list (all 20 tool chains, per-platform commands).

## 4. Architecture

```
src/index.ts          —— entry: Config / inject / apply
src/tools.ts          —— convert_file / list_conversions / check_converters
src/skills.ts         —— file-conversion skill (teaches the model how to use it)
src/engine/           —— ported conversion engine (logic identical to the original project)
  ├── registry.ts           —— format-matrix pure data + query functions (no Node deps)
  ├── fileTypeCategories.ts —— extension → category (pure data)
  ├── normalizeFiletype.ts  —— format alias normalization (jfif→jpeg, md→markdown, ...)
  ├── main.ts               —— mainConverter: auto-select converter + path/Buffer I/O
  └── <converter>.ts        —— 20 converters (ffmpeg/pandoc/vips/vcf/...)
```

### Key differences from the Web version

1. **File I/O**: input and output are local paths (the Web version uses HTTP upload + OSS storage);
2. **Timeout & cancellation**: injected through the engine's `execFileOverride` extension point —
   external CLI timeouts (`timeoutMs` config) auto-kill, and cancellation of the tool call
   (`exec.signal`) terminates the child process immediately without leaving zombies;
3. **Self-healing errors**: unsupported pairs return `availableTargets`, missing converters return
   install commands — the model can self-correct instead of failing repeatedly;
4. **Diagnosable**: `check_converters` exposes CLI availability to the model.

### Engine notes

- The engine is written in TypeScript with **zero third-party dependencies** (Node built-ins only):
  - imports use relative paths;
  - `main.ts` is the main converter and exposes an `execFileOverride` extension point (used for timeout / cancellation);
  - `detectOS()` is implemented for a Node environment (rather than browser UA detection).
- Because the engine has no runtime dependencies, it is self-contained and easy to maintain.

## 5. Development

```bash
pnpm --filter dsh-converter typecheck   # type check
pnpm --filter dsh-converter build       # tsc → build/
pnpm --filter dsh-converter smoke       # smoke test:
                                                   #   vcf→csv (pure JS) real conversion,
                                                   #   unsupported-format error hints,
                                                   #   format-matrix query, unload cleanup
```

plugins.readme_text: # dsh-plugins —— DeepSeek Harness 自研插件集 [![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-7c3aed.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.0--rc.2%2B-4f46e5.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) 九个跑在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)（DSH）桌面端里的**社区插件包**： 长期记忆、桌面宠物、GUI 皮肤、Token 用量报表、系统状态、旁支提问、消息撤回/编辑，以及给官方 Agent Teams 补上「让 teammates 散伙」的 fork。 全是真跑起来的插件——每个包都自带自检脚本，踩过的坑写进了各自的 README。 下面每个插件都配了 **DSH 桌面端实机截图**（真机抓的，不是渲染稿）。 ![DSH 桌面端「插件」页](docs/plugin-manager.png) > 上图是 DSH 侧栏「插件」页的「已安装」列表；其中「基础工具」「数学建模团队预设」两个本地预设包不在本仓库内。 --- ## 插件一览 | 插件 | 包名 / 版本 | 形态 | 一句话 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | [**记忆**](memory/) | `dsh-memory` 0.3.1 | 组合包 | 跨会话的 Markdown 长期记忆 + 四个 `memory_*` 工具；全局索引注入 `AGENTS.md` 托管区块、**工作区索引注入工作区自己的 `AGENTS.local.md`**，设置页可浏览编辑 | | [**桌面宠物**](pet/) | `dsh-pet` 0.1.0 | 普通包 | 浮层里的一只小家伙：5 种宠物、7 种状态，随皮肤换色、随 Agent 干活换表情 | | [**皮肤**](skins/) | `dsh-skins` 1.0.0 | 普通包 | 叠加在浅/深主题上的 7 套配色层（青花瓷 / 东京夜 / 水墨 / 青绿山水 / 卡布奇诺 / 中国风 / 莫兰迪），字体一起换 | | [**系统状态**](sysmon/) | `dsh-sysmon` 1.0.0 | 普通包 | 侧栏底部一排圆环：CPU / 内存 / 磁盘 IO / 双显卡（窄侧栏收敛成单个 CPU 环） | | [**Token 统计**](token-stats/) | `dsh-token-stats` 0.1.0 | 普通包 | 解析会话日志 `usage`：活跃度热力图 + 每日趋势 + 模型用量环形图 | | [**拓展包**](style-extras/) | `dsh-style-extras` 1.0.0 | 组合包 | 把**六个**成员（皮肤 / 系统状态 / Token 统计 / 桌面宠物 / 临时提问 / 消息撤回编辑）收进一张卡片统一启停 | | [**临时提问**](btw/) | `dsh-btw` 0.1.0 | 普通包 | 右侧栏「开始」页的 `/btw` 卡片：答案不进历史、没有工具、退出即消失 | | [**消息撤回 / 编辑**](message-edit/) | `dsh-message-edit` 0.1.0 | 普通包 | 已发送的用户消息可以**撤回**和**编辑**：原生操作行加两个图标钮，编辑态在原气泡位置无缝覆盖 | | [**Agent Teams Plus**](agent-team-plus/) | `@local/dsh-agent-team-plus` 0.2.0-rc.2.1 | 组合包 | 官方 Agent Teams 的 fork：成员上限 8 → 16，新增 `release_teammate`（成员散伙腾坑、可再雇新） | > 「组合包」= 自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`，在侧栏「插件」页里有独立卡片；「普通包」= 只有加载行， > 由 profile 的 patch 或某个组合包声明（本仓库里 `skins` / `sysmon` / `token-stats` / `pet` / > `btw` / `message-edit` 都由 `dsh-style-extras` 声明，所以它们在插件页里是同一张卡片下的成员行）。 --- ## 安装 ### 前置 - **DSH 桌面端 ≥ 0.2.0**（0.2.0 起旧 `.agent-presets/` 机制废除，插件走 bundle 声明）。 各包按 `0.2.0-rc.2` 的宿主契约开发与验证。 - 插件跑在 DSH 自带运行时里，**不需要**系统 Node / pnpm。 - 本仓库**不打包**任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 依赖，由你本机的 DSH 安装提供。 ### 方式 A：让 DSH 自己装（推荐） 把仓库 clone 到任意位置，然后在 DSH 里用 `plugin_manager` 逐个安装： ```powershell git clone https://github.com/OrinVoss/dsh-plugins.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\plugins-git" ``` 安装 `memory` 这个包（target 用**包目录的绝对路径**）： ``` plugin_manager → install_bundle → target: "C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\plugins-git\memory" ``` `install_bundle` 会**自动写好** profile 的两处声明：`dependencies` 里的 `link:` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里的包名。组合包（memory / style-extras / agent-team-plus） 装完即出现在「插件」页。 ⚠️ 装 `style-extras` 时**六个成员包也要 link 进 profile**（它的 patch 只声明加载行， 不提供包本体）： ``` plugin_manager → install_bundle → ...\skins plugin_manager → install_bundle → ...\sysmon plugin_manager → install_bundle → ...\token-stats plugin_manager → install_bundle → ...\pet plugin_manager → install_bundle → ...\btw plugin_manager → install_bundle → ...\message-edit plugin_manager → install_bundle → ...\style-extras ``` ### 方式 B：手工改 profile 编辑 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`： ```json { "dependencies": { "dsh-memory": "link:C:/Users/you/.dsh/plugins-git/memory" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-memory"] } } } ``` `link:` 只解决「包在哪」，`bundles` 才决定它是否出现在「插件」页。 **别在 profile 自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里再 insert 同一个 id**——`applyEntryPatches` 只做 push，同 id 插两次会加载两遍，第二次注册同名工具直接报 `already registered`。 ### 装完要重启 - **带客户端半边的插件**（设置页、侧栏面板、浮层、皮肤）：**必须重启桌面端**才生效—— DSH 桌面端没有「重新加载」菜单，F5 / Ctrl+R 也未接线。 - 纯宿主插件按 HMR 热重载；HMR 只盯入口文件，改了 `lib/` 里的模块要碰一下入口才重挂载。 ### 自检 ```powershell cd <包目录>; npm test # 有 test 脚本的包 ``` | 包 | 自检 | | --- | --- | | memory | `node selfcheck.cjs` / `plugintest.cjs` / `clienttest.cjs` / `lintmemory.cjs`（`npm test` 依次跑四套） | | pet | `node selfcheck.cjs` + `node test/hosttest.cjs` | | btw | `node selftest.cjs` | | token-stats | `node selftest.cjs`（`--live` 走真实会话日志） | | style-extras | `node selfcheck.cjs` | | agent-team-plus | `node test/setup.mjs && node test/run.mjs` | | skins / sysmon | 视觉验收走 `preview/`（见各包 README） | --- ## 各插件 ### 记忆 `dsh-memory` 跨会话的 Markdown 长期记忆库：`~/.dsh/memory` 下是 `INDEX.md` + 分主题目录，模型拿到 `memory_write` / `memory_search` / `memory_read` / `memory_forget` 四个工具。设置 → 记忆 里可浏览 / 编辑 / 删除，带健康度卡片；落盘即 `git commit`（只本地、从不 push）。 **注入分两个层级**，都走 DSH 自己的指令文件机制（`dsh-agent-instructions` 会加载它们）： | 层级 | 写进哪 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **全局索引** | `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` 的托管区块（``） | 全部条目**每条一行**，默认渲染该条目的 `brief`（**≤12 字压缩摘要**）；预算 `maxBlockBytes`，本机设 32 KB；所有工作区共用 | | **工作区索引** | 会话工作区自己的 **`AGENTS.local.md`** 托管区块（`injectProjectBlock`） | 只放**本工作区**的项目条目，预算独立（`maxProjectBlockBytes`，默认 8 KB）；默认文件不进版本控制，想进仓库就把 `projectBlockFile` 改成 `AGENTS.md` | > 2026-10-11：注入块改用 `brief` 之后，本机实测从 **29,293 B → 18,151 B（−38%）**，离 32 KB 预算的余量 > 由 10% 拉到 45%（此前再写十几条就会从末尾**静默截断**）。`brief` 是**存下来的压缩摘要**（`memory_write` > 的可选参数，≤12 汉字），不是渲染时切字符串——所以超长摘要会被**重写**而不是截断。`briefInIndex: false` > 一行回滚成完整 `description` 摘要。 > > 2026-10-09 还试过把这套注入换成三条「随插件销毁」的扩展点（专题地图 + 按需检索 + 压缩保护）， > 实测**专题地图会丢信息**，已整体回退到上面的文件区块方案，相关代码不再保留。 工作区区块有三条安全约定：只动托管区块、区块外一个字不改；本工作区没有项目条目**且**文件里没有 托管区块时什么都不做（不在你的仓库里凭空建文件）；条目删空后摘掉区块，文件因此变空就删掉文件。 细节与坑（`overwrite` 漏传 `section` 造成索引重复登记等）见 [memory/README.md](memory/README.md)。 **实机截图**（DSH 桌面端，下同）：设置 → 记忆 的管理页，以及插件页里的记忆卡片。 | 设置 → 记忆（健康度卡片 + 条目列表） | 插件页卡片 | | --- | --- | | | | ### 桌面宠物 `dsh-pet` 浮层里的一只小家伙，5 种宠物（像素猫 / 柴犬 / 锦鲤 / 史莱姆 / 小机器人）+ 7 种状态 （idle / work / wait / done / error / sleep / pat）。宿主半边只读会话事件折成快照， 客户端 1.2 s 轮询：气泡说的是人话（「翻文件…」「派小弟…」，绝不吐工具原名）、 点一下摸头、双击换宠物、按住拖到任意位置、大小 28–200px 可调，颜色跟随皮肤强调色。 预览见 `pet/preview/`。 **实机截图**：浮层里的小家伙站在界面右边缘（青花瓷皮肤下的小机器人，干活时顶上冒出「干活中…」气泡）、 设置 → 通用 → 宠物 那一行（5 只宠物、大小步进、位置与四个开关），以及插件页卡片。 | 宠物浮层（实机） | 浮层近景 | 对话气泡 | | --- | --- | --- | | | | | | 设置里的宠物行 | 插件页卡片（现已并入「拓展包」，改成那张卡片里的一行） | | --- | --- | | | | ### 皮肤 `dsh-skins` 把一整套配色以 `--dsw-*` 别名 token 叠加在当前主题上，随「设置 → 通用 → 皮肤」切换。 7 套皮肤 × 浅深两档 = 14 份完整调色板，字体各不相同。 **实机截图**：设置 → 通用 → 皮肤 的九宫格，以及三套皮肤换到整个界面上的样子（同一会话、同一排版，只有配色与字体变）。 | | | --- | | 设置 → 通用 → 皮肤：默认 / 莫兰迪 / 中国风 / 青花瓷 / 东京夜 / 水墨 / 青绿山水 / 卡布奇诺 | | 莫兰迪（低饱和灰调） | 中国风（宣纸 · 墨 · 朱砂） | 青花瓷（白瓷 · 靛青） | | --- | --- | --- | | | | | 另外七套的组件预览图在 `skins/preview/`。 ### 系统状态 `dsh-sysmon` 侧栏底部常驻一排占用圆环：**CPU / 内存 / 磁盘 / 核显 / 独显**，悬停看各自明细（磁盘那个还带读写 MB/s）； plugins.description: Aqua glassmorphism theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH v0.2.x / desktop v0.22.3+) — original by WYH66666666, adapted for 0.2.x
plugins.readme_text:
># @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-aqua

**Aqua** 是一层高自由度的玻璃质感主题（glassmorphism），套在 DeepSeek Harness 网页端：顶栏、侧边栏、输入框、统计行、轨迹视图全部变成磨砂玻璃片，支持流体背景或图片/视频壁纸。关掉总开关即完全还原原生界面，不改 DSH 任何一行源码。

> **署名 / Credits**
> - 原作者：**WYH66666666** — https://github.com/WYH66666666/DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin
> - 0.1.1-rc.2 适配：**du-u-uck** — https://github.com/du-u-uck/DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin
> - v0.2.x 适配（本仓库）：**acdsh4869**

> **修改声明 / Modification Notice**
>
> 本仓库是原作品的**修改 / 适配版**，不是原创。
> - 原作者（Original author）：**WYH66666666**
> - 修改内容（Changes）：DeepSeek Harness **0.2.x** 兼容适配
> - 修改日期（Date of modification）：**2026-10**
> - 维护仓库（Maintained at）：`acdsh4869/dsh-aqua-theme`
> - 许可（License）：**AGPL-3.0**（沿用上游许可）

![](assets/1.png)

![](assets/2.png)

![](assets/3.png)

![](assets/4.png)

## 特性

- **双模式**：**云母效果**把布局改成悬浮玻璃卡片（模糊度、磨砂度可调）；**兼容模式**保持原版排版不变，只把材质换成通用玻璃，其他插件的界面也会自动玻璃化
- **背景自由**：流体板（色调/深浅可调）或自定义图片/视频壁纸（铺满页面、比例不变，可单独调模糊度/磨砂度）；浅色壁纸配浅色模式、深色壁纸配深色模式观感更佳
- **背景亮度**：自动跟随深浅模式——深色模式 0–50 压暗、浅色模式 50–100 提亮，50 原样
- **粒子鲸鱼 / 小鱼 / 网状交互 / 鼠标辉光 / 悬停下压**等环境与悬停装饰，均可单独开关
- **一键恢复默认**：设置里的「恢复默认效果」按钮可把全部调节项恢复出厂默认
- 一键开关：关闭即完全还原原生界面，无残留

## 安装（v0.2.x 适配版）

> ⚠️ **npm 一键安装（`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-client-ui-aqua`）拉到的是未适配 v0.2.x 的旧版**，请勿使用，直到本适配版发布到 npm。

### 方式一：PowerShell 一键安装（推荐）

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/acdsh4869/dsh-aqua-theme/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

脚本会：① 从本仓库下载最新 Release；② 把插件链接进 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-client-ui-aqua`；③ 在 `profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml` 登记 `ui-aqua`（幂等，重复运行安全）。完成后**刷新 Web 界面**即可。

指定版本或分支：`-Version 'v2.0.0-rc.1'` / `-Version 'main'`；DSH 不在默认位置时加 `-DshHome`。

### 方式二：本地文件夹安装

下载或 clone 本仓库到本地，然后：

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command ".\install.ps1 -Source '绝对路径\dsh-aqua-theme' -Profile web"
```

本地路径会建立 **junction 软链**（实时生效，之后在本文件夹里改代码/重建会直接反映到 DSH，无需重装）。

**macOS / Linux（手动三步）：**

```sh
git clone https://github.com/acdsh4869/dsh-aqua-theme.git
ln -s "$PWD/dsh-aqua-theme" "$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-aqua"
```

再往 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 追加：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ui-aqua
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-aqua'
```

> 💡 也可以把整个仓库文件夹丢给其他 Agent 帮忙安装，有问题让它自己修复。

## 使用

刷新 Web 界面，Aqua **默认开启**：

- **总开关**：设置 → 插件 → 点击 **Aqua / dsh-client-ui-aqua** bundle 卡片进入详情页 → 玻璃主题开关卡片。
- **全部调节**：设置 → 通用设置 → 外观 正下方（无独立标题）—— 模式（云母/兼容）、模糊度/磨砂度、流体颜色、背景亮度、背景（流体/壁纸）、壁纸设置、环境装饰（鲸鱼/小鱼/网状交互）与悬停效果开关，以及「恢复默认效果」一键按钮。总开关关闭时整块调节自动隐藏，界面完全恢复原生样式。

> 若刷新后未出现 Aqua 卡片，重启 dsh web 进程后再试。

## 适配 v0.2.x 说明（当前版本）

本分发版针对 **DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`（含桌面端 v0.22.3 及以上）** 完成适配，版本号 `2.0.0-rc.1`。主要变更：

1. **`ctx.settingsScope` 服务被移除**：插件主卡片迁移到 **`plugins.bundle.config`**（keyed，key = npm 包名）。
2. **`ctx.slots.inject(name, factory)` 回归**：注册恢复为 `ctx.effect(() => ctx.slots.inject(...))`。
3. **`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` 消失**：`defineStore` 改用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`；`ctx.slots` 类型合并来自 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer/client`。
4. **图标改名**：`IconCheckOutline16` → `IconCheckOutlineRegular`。
5. **依赖声明**：`dsh.client.inject` = locale / ui-theme / ui-slots；peerDependencies 只留 `@deepseek-ai/cordis ~4.0.4` + `react ^18.2.0`（不声明 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer，宿主版本检查即通过）。
6. **构建管线**：新增 `scripts/wrap-client.mjs`——把 tsdown ESM 产物后处理为 DSH 要求的 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load(...)` 包裹格式，并直接从 `src/client/` 内联全局主题 CSS（rolldown 会摇掉纯副作用的 CSS 导入，导致早期构建主题整体缺失）。
7. **0.2.x 新布局容器透明化**：`centerCol`/`rightbarCol` 布局列与侧栏面板 frame 根节点的自绘不透明底色置为透明，流体背景可透至主区域。
8. **兼容模式修复**：0.2.x 里 `panel` 类片段命名整栏大容器，已从磨砂选择器中移除（避免半屏模糊）。
9. **新增「恢复默认效果」按钮**：一键恢复出厂默认（保留开关状态）。

细节与历史（含 0.1.1-rc.2 适配记录）见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 开发

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run bundle   # tsdown + tsc + wrap-client.mjs → 完整 lib/
```
